## Tips
-  Luck increases the chance for the bombs to explode, greatly increasing the damage output of the weapon.
- Due to how Luck affects the chances, having at least +150% Luck at level 1, +100% Luck after level 3 or +67% Luck after level 6 ensures that the bombs explode. With Limit Break, Luck can be obsoleted.
- Cherry Bomb can create a relatively safe space within all the explosions with increased  Amount and  Cooldown reduction.
- As the bombs are not limited by bounces, more  Duration and  Speed allow the bombs to hit more enemies over their lifetime.
## Trivia
- The design of Cherry Bomb might have been inspired by the Cherry Bomb from Ōkami, the explosions also have similar flower petal effects and sound effects.

Claimh Solais is an evolved weapon introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Pocket Knife [DLC], requiring  Torrona's Box at max level.
## Effects
Claimh Solais swings a large sword in an arc matching the faced direction. Every 7th activation swings an even larger sword that covers a wider area which deals 1.7x damage. This damage is multiplicative with Critical Hits.
It also increases  Might,  Armor, and Crit Damage globally based on the number of enemies on screen. The max bonus for each stat, being +50% Might, +5 Armor, and +100% Crit Damage, are multiplied by OnScreenEnemies/300 before being added to their respective stats. This scalar can not go over 1, reaching its limit at 300 on-screen enemies.
Compared to  Pocket Knife, Claimh Solais has increased Base Damage, but a slower  Cooldown.
## Arcanas
-  Slash (XVI) - doubles the damage of Claimh Solais' critical hits, causing them to deal 6x damage.

## Trivia
- The name Claimh Solais is likely a play on ‘Claíomh Solais’ which means "Sword of Light" in the Irish language. The Claíomh Solais is also one of the four great treasures of the Tuatha Dé Danann, where it is associated with Nuada Airgetlám, so it is sometimes referred to as the Sword of Nuada. Ownership of the sword is less commonly attributed to Lugh rather than to Nuada in Middle Irish mythology, so in some texts it is referred to as the Sword of Lugh.

Clear Asteroids is an evolved weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Clear Debris, requiring  Mini Guardian at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50,000 as reward.
## Effects
Clear Asteroids creates a field of asteroids that drift across the screen from right to left. A green crosshair fires pairs of bolts at the asteroids, destroying them with an explosion that also damages nearby enemies. Amount increases the explosion per asteroid being shot down.
Clear Asteroids no longer has Pierce, gains a massive increase in Base Damage and its Cooldown cut in half in exchanged for a much lower Amount, as the nature of their attack is very different. It has a tiny decrease in Interval.

Clear Debris is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Guardian Pina. It is unlocked by reaching level 50 with Guardian.
It can be evolved into  Clear Asteroids with  Mini Guardian at max level. The passive item will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches level 2.
## Effects
Clear Debris forms a vertical chute on the screen, it does not move with the player. Debris fall through the chute from the top, if they did not hit any enemies, they are teleported back to the top and falling with greater speed until Duration ends.
Clear Debris has a 0.5 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every half a second by the same debris. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses or bounces off a wall, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Levels
Clear Debris has 8 levels. At max level, Clear Debris has +6 Base Damage, +60% Projectile Speed, +1.5 second to Duration, +10 Amount, +8 Pierce, and -0.04 seconds of Interval.

Clock Lancet is a non-damaging weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Iguana Gallo Valletto. It is unlocked by picking up an  Orologion.
Its evolution is  Infinite Corridor, which requires  Silver Ring and  Gold Ring at maximum level.
## Effects
Clock Lancet fires a thin, freezing beam around the character in twelve directions clockwise one at a time. The freezing beam does no damage, but will freeze any enemy it hits.
Bonuses to  Duration will add to the time enemies are frozen. Bonuses to  Cooldown will increase the fire rate of the weapon.

-  Blood Astronomia (XXI) - Allows Clock Lancet to place a damaging zone on the ground that gradually make enemies move slower permanently.
-  Crystal Cries (XII) - Enemies frozen by Clock Lancet will drop Crystalized Souls when killed.

## Tips
- The freezing beam travels around the player like a clock, shooting out at "12 o'clock," then at "1 o'clock," and so on. This means the freezing beam only has 12 directions it can fire. This also makes the freezing beam very predictable.
- It is possible to keep freezing the same enemy multiple times. This is especially useful for bosses and  The Reaper.
- Frozen enemies cannot damage the player, so it is safe to touch them.
- If the player is stuck in a horde of enemies, they can use Clock Lancet to freeze a group of enemies to attempt to escape from the horde of enemies.
- This weapon can be useful to temporarily freeze some enemies that surround a  Coffin.
- Enemies become more vulnerable to freezing if the character has  Garlic or  Soul Eater.
- Since it doesn't do damage, it cannot be used on its own and instead acts as a supporting weapon. It is best when using weapons that lack crowd control, as it can help stop the player from being swarmed.

## Trivia
- The combined description of Silver Ring and Gold Ring (passive items needed to evolve Clock Lancet) is "Wear with Clock Lancet", which is a reference to "Wear in Clock Tower", the combined description of the Silver and Gold Rings in the game Castlevania: Symphony of the Night.
- Furthermore, Clock Lancet's sprite resembles the Shield Rod from the Castlevania series.
- The weapon itself is a nod to the Italian word "Lancetta", meaning 'pointer' but commonly used to refer to a clock's hand ("lancetta dell'orologio").
- Clock Lancet and Laurel are the only weapons with max a level of 7 instead of the usual 8.
- When the weapon is used for the first time in a match, the direction of the first beam shot by the Clock Lancet would be where "1" on a circular clock would be.

The Clock Tower is a weapon union from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of  Endo Gears,  Peri Pendulum,  Myo Lift, and  Epi Head.
## Effects
Clock Tower merely converts its base weapons into hidden weapons, "uniting" them as it reduces the total weapon slots used by 3. Damage done by the hidden weapons is added to the Clock Tower's total damage.
Damage is still affected by  Amount and  Orologions found. Clock Tower halves the  Cooldown of its components, making them fire twice as fast.
- All Clockwork weapons gain a +(1/3)x damage multiplier per +1 Amount, up to a max of x3.333... at +10 Amount
- All Clockwork weapons gain a Base Damage bonus in accordance to log(OrologionsFound), meaning they gain +10 Damage for every 10x in Orologions found, starting at approximately +3 Base Damage at 2 Orologions found.
Unlike most weapons, the Clock Tower cannot Limit Break. This is due to the fact Clock Tower's attacks are from hidden weapons, which can not limit break.
## Arcanas
-  Out of Bounds (XII) - Increases the likelihood of finding  Orologions which increase the Clock Tower's damage.
-  Hail from the Future (X) - Occasionally spawns Orologions whenever the character levels up, indirectly increasing the Clock Tower's damage.

## Tips
- Increasing Amount and collecting  Orologions greatly increases this weapon's damage.
-  Greatest Jubilee can be a great pairing with Clockwork weapons due to its ability to spawn light sources, which can drop Orologions.
-  Out of Bounds (XII) and  Hail from the Future (X) make it easier to find Orologions, and therefore contribute to the Clockwork weapons' unique ability of gaining damage from Orologions found.
- Obtaining the Clock Tower will complete the "Be the Clock Tower" secret.
- The Clock Tower cannot be obtained from the  Super Candybox II Turbo.
## Trivia
- This weapon is a reference to the Clock Tower in Castlevania games, which is a recurring area throughout the series.

The Coat of Arms is a weapon selector from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It becomes available at the start of a stage when unlocked and equipped by an eligible character. It allows the player to select one of the vampire-killing tools, which are:
- 8 evolvable base game weapons:  Whip,  Axe,  Knife,  Santa Water,  Runetracer,  King Bible,  Cross, and  Lightning Ring
- 8 evolvable Ode to Castlevania weapons:  Curved Knife,  Shuriken,  Javelin,  Iron Ball,  Discus,  Silver Revolver,  Hand Grenade, and  Wine Glass
- 4 of the Master Librarian weapons:  Svarog Statue,  Troll Bomb,  Hydro Storm, and  Grand Cross (once unlocked)
## Unlocking
The Coat of Arms is unlocked by evolving all 16 evolvable vampire-killing tools, which refers to all the weapons above except  Svarog Statue,  Troll Bomb,  Hydro Storm, and  Grand Cross. This does not have to be done in a single run.

Confodere is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Shanoa. It is unlocked by defeating 1000 enemies with  Shanoa.
It can be evolved into  Vol Confodere at max level, which can be further evolved into  Melio Confodere.
After obtaining  Black Disk, Evolving Confedere unlocks  Albus as playable character.
It can be selected when using the  Ebony Diabologue.
## Effects
Confodere attacks nearby enemies with a fast combo of slashes. If there is no enemies in range, a crimson circle will occur around the character, which shows its exact attacking range (affected by Area). When enemies are in range, all enemies within are attacked, while any that enter during the attack are unaffected.
This weapon also gains an explosive blast from the player character when the range indicator appears and disappears when in line of sight of an enemy.

Crimson Shroud is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Laurel, and requires  Metaglio Left and  Metaglio Right at max level.
## Effects
Crimson Shroud creates a shield that protects from damage and briefly makes the player invulnerable upon triggering. The shield's color changes based on the remaining charges: one is green, two is a transparent green with orange inside, and three is red. It now also causes retaliatory damage when a charge is used; the explosion creates a few shockwaves and a transparent red circle surrounding a quickly expanding and retracting inverted color circle centered slightly above the player. Additionally, all incoming damage is capped at 10.
Despite lacking Base Damage, it deals retaliatory damage with the Base Damage being the damage dealt to the player, capping at 100 damage received. The value is not reduced by Armor or Crimson Shroud's ability. It is then multiplied by Might and Curse, and each Armor point also increases the damage by 10% additively. Area increases the size of the explosion. Cooldown still recharges the shields faster. Amount creates more explosions. This retaliatory damage also does extra damage to  The Reaper equal to 1% of its max health, killing it within a reasonable amount of time.
Crimson Shroud can attack and defeat the otherwise intangible  Stalkers and  Drowners in Dairy Plant, Gallo Tower, Cappella Magna, and The Bone Zone before minute 30, causing them to drop  Treasure Chests.
## Arcana
-  Divine Bloodline (IX) - Allows Crimson Shroud to increase Max Health by 0.5 when enemies are killed by its retaliatory damage.

## Tips
- Crimson Shroud is a great weapon to take when you already have 4 or 5 good weapons and you are set for the run. Its extra protection may seem useless if you are already killing everything before you take damage, but its automatic nature protects from stupid mistakes and being overwhelmed.
- Despite the first charge having the same color as the final one for the Laurel, the max charge still remains at three. Be careful when the shield is displaying yellow.
- When the shields are drained, the explosion will not happen, but the damage the character takes will still be capped out at 10.
- The retaliatory explosion benefits from Curse, Might, and Armor. They are all individual multipliers, making the explosions damage grow exponentially.
- Crimson Shroud's incoming damage cap works on  The Reaper, with a few Armor they cannot kill your character instantly, making it viable for any character to survive their onslaught and kill them eventually with its specialized damage.
- In fact, using this weapon against the Reaper is one of the only ways for it to drop  Golden Eggs (and summon the  White Hand), the other being the use of the  Infinite Corridor.
- While having both weapons makes it much easier to kill the Reaper, it is possible to destroy it with the Shroud alone. However, since the Shroud does not make you invincible and has a Cooldown period, while the Reaper attacks relentlessly and will take some time to whittle down, you may need a way to regenerate health, like  Bloody Tear; have enough Cooldown to be permanently invulnerable; or a way to keep the Reaper away from your character during the Shroud's cooldown, like an unevolved  Clock Lancet or  Mirage Robe.
## Trivia
- The inverted color explosion may be a reference to Negative Zone, Luigi's Final Smash in Super Smash Bros. Brawl, where it also creates an inverted color aura around him.
- The Crimson Shroud may be a reference to the Crimson Cloak from the Castlevania series.

Cross is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Krochi Freetto. It is unlocked by picking up a  Rosary.
Its evolution is  Heaven Sword, which requires  Clover.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from  Coat of Arms [DLC].
## Effects
Cross fires a spinning projectile at the closest enemy. After traveling for a bit, it reverses its direction and travels in a straight line until it leaves the screen, much like a boomerang. Cross has infinite pierce.
 Speed determines how far the crosses can initially travel before they return.
## Arcanas
-  Divine Bloodline (IX) - Allows Cross to deal extra flat damage based on  Armor.
-  Waltz of Pearls (XI) - Allows Cross's projectiles to bounce off the edges of the screen twice. Upon bouncing, Cross completely reverses its horizontal and vertical speed instead of just one of them.
## Levels
Cross has 8 levels. At max level, Cross has +30 Base Damage, +20%  Area, +50%  Speed, and +2  Amount.

## Tips
- Cross has a short range when initially thrown, stopping a little ways after it hits an enemy. However, it will fly to the other end of the screen when returning. Because of this, it is most effective when there are a lot of enemies, to ensure it pierces through as many enemies on the return trip as possible.
- The automatic targeting nature of the weapon is both a blessing and a curse. While it removes the mental load of aiming, the closest enemy might not always be the enemy the player is trying to attack. Cross should be considered a supporting weapon, and not necessarily a main damage dealer.

Crossed Wires is an evolved weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Lucky Swipe, requiring  Mini Engineer at max level.
## Effects
Crossed Wires creates stubs of four broken electrical wires on the left and right side of the screen. The wires are of different colors in a random order: red, blue, yellow, and magenta. One by one wires will cross the screen from the stub on the left to the corresponding stub on the right, damaging enemies in the wire's path. If the wires match, they will connect and begin sending periodic pulses of electricity through the wire, each pulse can deal damage individually. Once all four wires are connected they will send a continuous stream of electricity for a few seconds, then all the wires will disconnect and the process will start over again. Projectile Speed increases the speed of the wire connecting. Cooldown increases the frequency of the pulses. Duration extends the continuous electricity phase. Luck increases the chance of the wire connecting successfully, with the the connecting speed accelerating if it fails.

Curved Knife is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Grant Danasty. Technically, it is unlocked upon getting it to level 1, but in practice (as all weapons start at that level), it unlocks when it's obtained for the first time.
It can be evolved into  Bwaka Knife with  Bracer.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from  Coat of Arms.
## Effects
Curved Knife fires a sickle towards a random enemy, which can bounce up to 3 times and pierce enemies.

# Dairy Cart
This article is about the carts in Dairy Plant. For the weapon used by Bianca Ramba, see Carréllo.

Dairy Cart is a destructible, akin to light sources, that can be found in Dairy Plant. It also functions as a special weapon.
In the stage, there are rails in predetermined locations in the tileset, where the carts can spawn on their left end. When the player deals 40 damage to a cart, it gets launched at high speed towards the other end of the rail. Any enemies that come in contact with it are dealt 100 damage.
Dairy Carts have a special interaction with the Stalker in the Dairy Plant, causing it to drop a Treasure Chest when killed by a cart and trigger  Toastie to appear when  Exdash Exiviiq is already unlocked.
Dairy Cart can attack and defeat the otherwise intangible Stalkers in Dairy Plant before minute 30, causing them to drop lower quality chests.
## Trivia
- As a weapon, Dairy Cart can also be affected by Amount and Cooldown, however, it is not possible to obtain it in this form in an unmodded game.

Damnation is an evolved weapon in Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Baal'Thamut. It is the evolution of  Blacken Firmament and max level  Torrona's Box.
## Effects
Damnation retains similar behavior to  Blacken Firmament, treating its predecessor as a hidden weapon. When evolving from Blacken Firmament, Damnation will retain all Limit Break upgrades given to Blacken Firmament. Acquiring Damnation will increase the Base Damage of Blacken Firmament by 40. If the player picks Damnation from a  Super Candybox II Turbo, then a hidden Blacken Firmament will be granted at max level.
Compared to Blacken Firmament, Damnation has +165 Base Damage, +100% Area, -5 Amount, +0.5 seconds of Duration, -0.3 seconds of Repeat Interval, and +0.25 seconds of Hitbox Delay.
Every 30 enemies erased will pause Blacken Firmament from firing and, instead, cause the void at the top of the screen to drip down, creating a black hole in the center of the screen, attracting nearby enemies. Any enemy that comes into contact with this zone will be instantly erased. Damnation's black hole effect will last for the Duration of Blacken Firmament. Enemies with instant kill resistance will instead take normal damage.
If the player is playing as  Megalo Sargon or  Baal'Thamut, then the above black hole effect will be permanently active instead of alternating with Blacken Firmament.
Damnation deals  Hell damage.
Damnation retains Blacken Firmament's 0.5 second Hitbox Delay. However, Damnation itself has a 0.5 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 0.75 seconds by the central black hole. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often. 
## Arcanas
-  Tragic Princess (III) - Allows the Blacken Firmament part of Damnation to fire faster while moving, increasing with  Move Speed.

Dark Frogamorphosis is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of  Anura [DLC] at max level and  Soul Eater.
## Effects
Dark Frogamorphosis places a circular dark purple aura around the player that pulls particles and pulses inward, alternating between one and two pulses, dealing damage to enemies inside it. Frogs no longer spawn normally. Instead, each enemy that enters the aura can be pulled in by a tongue and be eaten, which also morphs them into a green frog.
Enemies resistant to Rosary are excluded from the pool of enemies the tongue projectile can select from. When an enemy is morphed into a frog, it despawns the enemy and adds the enemy's health to the weapon's current inflicted damage directly, rather than dealing damage to the enemy. After a 400ms delay, a frog is spawned where the enemy was.
Despite the decrease in  Area to match Anura's Area, the aura is set to be slightly larger than Soul Eater. The aura's Base Damage is greatly increased as it matches Anura's.  Amount,  Cooldown, and Interval matches Soul Eater's as frogs do not spawn as an attack; as Dark Frogamorphosis cannot benefit from  Blood Astronomia (XXI), its base Amount no longer matters.  Duration matches Soul Eater and is slightly increased compared to Anura's, but it no longer multiplies the number of frogs spawned. Pool Limit is halved for the frogs and tongues.
Cooldown acts similarly to Hitbox Delay for the aura. Damage will be dealt instantly to an enemy if they have never been in the circle before, after which they cannot be hit by it again until Dark Frogamorphosis's Cooldown is over, even if they temporarily leave its area.
Enemies hit by the aura will take more knockback and be more vulnerable to freeze. If the enemy is not immune to debuff, each hit applies +0.3 knockback to the enemy until the maximum knockback they can take and -0.1 to freeze resistance until it reaches 0.
The Cooldown of the tongue is affected by player  Amount, the formula is CalculatedCooldown*2/(PlayerAmount+1).
The frog has a 1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every second by the same frog. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
Dark Frogamorphosis gains +1 damage every 60 health healed, capping at +100 damage or 6,000 health healed. This damage is just a flat increase and does not benefit from  Might. The source of the healing to boost Dark Frogamorphosis's damage does not matter, passive  Recovery, the healing from  Floor Chicken, even the heal from  Revival counts toward damage healed. However, only healing that actually takes place is counted, overhealing does not. The cap is greatly increased, and Dark Frogamorphosis retains the damage bonus from Soul Eater.
Dark Frogamorphosis has a chance to generate  Little Hearts that heal 1 health upon killing an enemy, multiplied by Recovery. This chance is unaffected by  Luck. Instead, it is based on how strong the attack is: if the damage dealt multiplied by 3/140 is greater than a randomly generated value between 0 and 1, a Little Heart will spawn. The chance benefits from the higher Base Damage and flat damage cap.
## Arcanas
-  Gemini (I) - Creates counterpart  Speculo Anura. It is functionally the same as Anura at max level, creating a magic circle below the character which summons purple frogs, but does not benefit from Limit Breaking.
-  Tragic Princess (III) - Reduces Dark Frogamorphosis's  Cooldown when the character is moving. It is affected by  Move Speed.

## Tips
- The debuffs applied by Dark Frogamorphosis' aura are its most useful ability late game. Strong enemies that take multiple hits to kill will be easier to keep at bay thanks to increased knockback, and some boss enemies can become vulnerable to freezing when kept in the circle for long enough.
- Combined with a weapon to constantly knock enemies away, such as  Unholy Vespers or  Mannajja, Dark Frogamorphosis can enable the player to sit entirely still.
-  Clock Lancet has natural synergy with Dark Frogamorphosis; it decreases the enemy's resistance to freezing, allowing the Clock Lancet to freeze bosses, and even very powerful frozen enemies can easily be killed by keeping Dark Frogamorphosis's area of effect over them.
- If the player intends to stay idle, Dark Frogamorphosis works well when paired with the  Attractorb, as enemies that die instantly to Dark Frogamorphosis may drop experience just out of reach of the player.
- The aura can kill most weak enemies instantly. Killing swarms of weak enemies can lead to windfalls of Little Hearts which can increase the damage output of Dark Frogamorphosis.
- Because Dark Frogamorphosis does not count any overhealing, you have to occasionally take damage and heal back up in order to gain stacks. Due to this, it does not pair well with  Laurel. With the  Bloody Tear,  Hollow Heart, and  Armor (for instance), the player can take less risk in taking a lot of damage, just to heal up easily to empower Dark Frogamorphosis.
## Trivia
- This weapon is based on Dark Metamorphosis spell from Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, healing when the player character comes in contact with blood. Dark Frogamorphosis lashes out with the tongue of green frogs to eat enemies whole to heal instead.

Dark Iron Shield is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Iron Shield, requiring  Parm Aegis.
## Effects
As a much powerful version of Iron Shield, Dark Iron Shield summons a dark shield. When taking damage, it retaliates with spinning sword projectiles within a 90 degrees cone shape upon triggering. This damage from the projectiles scales with Armor.
It also has a "Critical Attack", which doubles sword projectiles within 180 degrees and deals double damage.
## Arcanas
Divine Bloodline (IX) - Killing enemies with Dark Iron Shield increases Max Health by 0.5.
## Levels
| Level | Description
| Level 1 | Evolved Iron Shield. Critical hits retaliate with spinning swords.
## Notes
- If the character also holds  Guardian's Targe or  Sacred Beasts Tower Shield, Dark Iron Shield will be summoned behind the character instead.

Dark Rift is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be purchased and unlocked from  Master Librarian [DLC] for 2,800. It is the starting weapon of  Count Olrox [DLC].
Its union is  Legacy of Death: Soul River [DLC], which also requires  Death Spiral.
## Effects
Dark Rift creates a horizontal line of vertical damaging zones.
It is the weapon version of the same effect from  Mormegil Tip [DLC].
## Levels
Dark Rift has 8 levels. At max level, Dark Rift has +20 Base Damage, +40% Area, +4 Amount, and -1 second of Cooldown.

Darkness Illusion is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of  Svarog Statue [DLC] at max level and  Valkyrie Turner.
## Effects
Darkness Illusion is an improved version of  Valkyrie Turner, additionally summoning 2 clones that summon their own projectiles, while retaining the rest of Valkyrie Turner's behaviors. Compared to  Svarog Statue, Darkness Illusion has increased Base Damage,  Area, and  Amount, faster  Cooldown and Interval, and decreased  Duration.
Darkness Illusion has a Hitbox Delay of 1 second when staying on the ground, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than once every second by the same flame. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Arcanas
-  Heart of Fire (XIX) - Allows Darkness Illusion's lasers to explode upon contact, dealing half of their base damage in an area.
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Flames drift towards the nearest enemy, and gains a  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.
-  Heir of Fate (XIX) - The  Fire damage from this weapon would make the enemies it kills drop  Scorched Souls, a pickup that increases  Max Health and  Might.

Daybreaker Tip is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Vibhuti Whip, requiring  Candelabrador.
## Effects
Being a tip, the Daybreaker Tip evolution does not change the weapon's function, but simply adds on to it. Unlike most tips, this tip provides two effects, unspoken by its description due to limitations. Every 7th activation of this weapon triggers an  Arrow of Goth effect that spawns several spiritual bows and arrows to shoot through a long, infinite horizontal line of foes (not affected by Amount/Area) and pierces through each enemy it hits. On top of this, the dust cloud of the Vibhuti Whip gains a buff to its power, increasing the amount of dust clouds it creates if it lands a critical hit.

Death Spiral is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Axe, and requires the  Candelabrador. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
It is the starting weapon of  Mask of the Red Death,  Death, and one of the starting weapons of  missingN▯.
Its union is  Legacy of Death: Soul River [DLC], which also requires  Dark Rift [DLC] at max level.
## Effects
Death Spiral shoots out nine red spinning scythes around the player. Each scythe has extremely high Pierce and are bigger, with damage reduction to compensate. It also has a slower  Speed which make them stay on screen for longer.
Death Spiral scales with the character's  Area stat multiplied by 1.2, decreased by 0.1 compared to Axe. While this may seem like a downside, Death Spiral base Area is increased and in total it gives a multiplier of 1.44. Also, Area bonuses from the character is capped at 10 times the base value. In the end, Axe will still cap at 10 times bigger the original and Death Spiral will cap at 12 times bigger.
## Arcanas
-  Iron Blue Will (VII) - Allows Death Spiral's projectiles to bounce off of the edges of the screen once. Upon bouncing, the projectile completely reverses its horizontal and vertical speed instead of just one of them according to the edge.
-  Slash (XVI) - Allows Death Spiral to critical hit. Its critical hits deal 4x damage and have 30% chance to occur. This chance is affected by  Luck.
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Death Spiral now aims at nearest enemy instead of shooting around the player, and gains a  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.

## Tips
- The fixed direction of the scythes is vastly different compared to the arcing behavior of  Axe. While the consistency makes Death Spiral easier to understand and use, the player will no longer be able to focus all of the axes directly north into enemies for easy damage.
- However, as the player moves in one direction, the scythes on screen will never despawn. If the  Move Speed is similar to the  Speed, more and more scythes can be stacked and become a wall of damage up until the weapon's Pool Limit.
- Death Spiral's scythes benefit greatly from  Area bonuses as they are big already and even have a bonus multiplier. The bigger they are, the more enemies they will be able to pierce through. Luckily,  Candelabrador is what evolves Axe anyway.
-  Cooldown bonuses are very effective for Death Spiral, because of its slow cooldown.  Might bonuses are also highly effective, due to the bonuses being applied to a weapon with already very high base damage.  Amount bonuses cause scythes to cover more screen area and reduce blind spots.
- Death Spiral can deal critical damage after  Slash (XVI) is picked. The more  Luck the player has, the more likely they are to deal critical hits.
- When playing as  Mask of the Red Death, it is possible to obtain Axe in addition to Death Spiral. However, it cannot be evolved into Death Spiral.
- With  Clock Lancet, the player can freeze enemies and stand directly on top of them to maximize damage, as the projectiles spawn on top of the enemies.
## Trivia
- This weapon is inspired by the Axe sub-weapon and Death's Scythe weapon from the Castlevania series. The Item Crash of the axe sub-weapon summons a circle of axes that spiral outward from the player, similar to Death Spiral, except Death Spiral shoots scythes straight out.

Descent Into Misery is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Nameless Fool. It can alternatively be unlocked in the  Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "itsfinallycomingtopc".
Its union is  Shimmering Sands, which also requires  Kyra-Stones.
## Effects
Descent Into Misery creates a red glint at the player character and, after 0.7 seconds, creates a series of red slashes that take up a portion of the screen.  Area will increase the the sizes of Descent Into Misery's slashes by the square root of itself, leading to a significantly diminished effect.
Below level 3, only one slash can be created. As the weapon's level increases, granting it more attacks in its combo, changing direction between slashes will cause it to continue its current combo. On a critical hit, the weapon automatically proceed with the rest of the combo, still being limited by level, but not requiring player input. 
Every +1 Amount over the base value that Descent Into Misery possesses will grant it +10 flat damage. Note that this is not the same as Base Damage, and so it does not get multiplied by  Might.
## Levels
Descent Into Misery has 9 levels. At max level, Descent Into Misery has +20 Base Damage, +4 attacks in its combo, -2 seconds of Cooldown, +5% Critical chance, and -45% Max Health.

Dextro Custos is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is one of the starting weapon of  Cornell [DLC]. It is unlocked by upgrading it to Level 6. It can be found in Maze of Dracula's Castle (at the bottom of the Clock Tower) after unlocking  Serpent Gate [DLC].
Its union is  Trinum Custodem [DLC], which also requires  Sinestro Custos [DLC] and  Centralis Custos [DLC] at max level.
## Effects
Dextro Custos summons the black, fiery head of Cerberus that bites horizontally. It ignores  Speed and  Duration.  Amount increases the number of bite attacks.

Dies Irae is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of  Arrow of Goth [DLC] at max level and  Mannajja.
## Effects
Dies Irae functions as a mix between  Mannajja and  Arrow of Goth [DLC], summoning the same pulsing wave as Mannajja in the center of the screen, instead being colored red. Upon hit,  Alamaric Snipers will rain down arrows from the upper corners of the screen, aiming below the player and dealing damage to any enemy in their path. There is a 5% chance to summon extra Alamaric Snipers, which will shoot even more arrows above and below the normal path. This chance is affected by  Luck.
Dies Irae has lower base damage,  Cooldown, and  Amount, while having a large increase to  Area and knockback.
Dies Irae has a 1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than once every second by the same pulse. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Arcanas
-  Heart of Fire (XIX) - Allows Dies Irae to explode upon contact with an enemy, dealing 1.25x its base damage in an area.
- Unlike most weapons, that deal half of their base damage in an area, Dies Irae multiplies the damage of Heart of Fire by 2.5.
-  Heir of Fate (XIX) - The  Fire damage from this weapon would make the enemies it kills drop  Scorched Souls, a pickup that increases  Max Health and  Might.

Diver Mines is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Newt Plissken [DLC]. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Newt Plissken.
Its evolution is  Atmo-Torpedo, which requires  Weapon Power-Up [DLC] and  Attractorb.
## Effects
Diver Mines fires a rolling mine at the faced direction, which goes downwards seemingly affected by gravity, just like  Axe. This rolling mine will also travel along walls or the edge of the screen once it reaches them. It creates an explosion when hitting an enemy or when  Duration ends, dealing damage in a radius affected by  Area, though note the mines themselves do not increase in size.

Armor also affects listed weapons' damage and reflects enemy damage. Character gains bonus damage depending on missing Health. Defeating enemies with retaliatory damage gives +0.5 Max Health.
Divine Bloodline (IX) is one of the Arcanas in Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by reaching level 50 while playing as  Suor Clerici.
 Richter Belmont [DLC] starts with this Arcana.
## Overview
While Divine Bloodline (IX) is active, multiple effects occur:
- The following weapons now deal +5 flat damage per Armor, up to +250 flat damage:
-  Cross
-  King Bible
-  Garlic
-  Santa Water
-  Lightning Ring
-  Song of Mana
-  Vento Sacro
-  Victory Sword
-  Silver Wind [DLC]
- All weapons gain +0.1 flat damage per missing HP below the character's Max Health, uncapped.
- Enemies that touch the character take 10 flat damage per Armor.
- Killing any enemy with "retaliatory damage" gives the character +0.5 Max Health. Retaliatory damage includes the touch damage from this Arcana, as well as the on-character effects of following weapons:
-  NO FUTURE
-  Victory Sword
-  Pako Battiliar and  Mazo Familiar
-  Crimson Shroud
-  Night Sword [DLC] and  Muramasa [DLC]
-  Eskizzibur [DLC] and  Legionnaire [DLC]
-  Iron Shield [DLC] and  Dark Iron Shield [DLC]
- Damage does not have to be taken to do retaliatory damage.
-  Embrace of Gaea
-  Stone Skull [DLC] has innate retaliation damage that is not associated with any weapon.
## Tips
- This Arcana has a unique interaction with  Legionnaire [DLC]. because the constant stream of clones created by the weapon are considered dealing retaliatory damage, this activates the Arcana's ability with every kill from these clone projectiles. Combined with the fact that current health is not restored at the same time, this also translates to a flat damage increase per enemy killed by the clones provided there's nothing healing the character. With Boogaloo of Illusions (XVIII) that can allow the clones to cover the whole screen and the weapon can wipe out bosses with ease.
- This Arcana also has a similarly inflated interaction with  Mazo Familiar. The weapon gets most of its damage from retaliating, which increases max health with this Arcana. Mazo Familiar's damage is boosted by Max Health. This creates a feedback loop where almost every use of this weapon boosts its own damage (it still triggers normally which does not increase max hp).
- Weapons like  Garlic that deal low but fast ticking damage benefit greatly from the flat damage bonuses.
- The increasing  Might from this Arcana is purely visual and increases by +1% for every flat damage the player gains. With a high enough number, the player can approximate how much more flat damage they are dealing with this value.
- Due to the scaling Max Health that Divine Bloodline (IX) provides, it synergizes well with  Hollow Heart and  Metaglio Left, however the benefit provided by these do not affect any Max Health gained after the items have been leveled.
- The vastly increased health from this Arcana means it is not recommended for characters that want to trigger Last Breath or CriticalHP skills more than once, as you can quickly find yourself unable to heal to full HP no matter how many healing items you consume or healing weapons you equip. Further, even if you did, it can become impossible to actually lose that much health.
## Trivia
- The name of this Arcana is a reference to the song "Divine Bloodlines", which is the theme song of the Abandoned Village in Castlevania: Rondo of Blood.
- Divine Bloodline (IX) can be unlocked in the  Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "leremita", which means "the hermit" in Italian.
- This makes Divine Bloodline (IX) a representation of The Hermit Major Arcana card, symbolizing spiritual guidance, introspection, seclusion, prudence, caution, and self-reflection.
- This is reflected in its ability of amplifying damage reduction, retaliatory damage, and providing unique boosts to unevolved base weapons.
- This Arcana is one of the most prominent cases, alongside  Twilight Requiem (II), of an Arcana applying mostly to base weapons but not their evolutions, even when said weapons are not mechanically different.
- Divine Bloodline as a standalone weapon creates missing texture squares on the character that can knockback enemies. It can also be affected by  Amount and  Cooldown, which is not the case when it is an Arcana effect as it is applied as contact damage.

Dominus Agony is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by defeating 8,000 enemies with  Barlowe [DLC].
Its union is  Power of Sire [DLC], which also requires  Dominus Anger [DLC] and  Dominus Hatred [DLC] at max level.
As an ambiguous power, it can be picked from  Ebony Diabologue [DLC].
## Effects
Dominus Agony creates a green magic circle centered on the character that does not do damage. It increases the  Might,  Speed,  Duration, and  Area of the character themselves, other players, and followers within range, +8% per level and up to +48% for each stat.
This weapon drains the health of any character in its range based on their current level and health. This drain is equal to (3+PlayerLevel)*HealthPercentage. Meaning that this weapon will drain more health as a character accumulates level, but will drain less health as they lose health. This damage can kill the characters it affects, but is mitigated by  Armor.
## Levels
Dominus Agony has 6 levels. At max level, Dominus Agony provides +48% Might, Speed, Duration, and Area to any ally in the circle.

Dominus Anger is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be picked up from in the area of the Ode to Castlevania stage. It is unlocked by upgrading it to level 6. It is one of the optional starting weapons of  Barlowe [DLC].
Its union is  Power of Sire [DLC], which also requires  Dominus Hatred [DLC] and  Dominus Agony [DLC] at max level.
## Effects
Dominus Anger fires two big, piercing fireballs similar to  Hellfire. Unlike Hellfire, once fired, the fireballs will stay for a second and then accelerate. This weapon drains 1 health per activation, but will not kill the character if they have 1 health left.
Dominus Anger has a 2 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every two seconds by the same fireball. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Arcanas
-  Heir of Fate (XIX) - The  Fire damage from this weapon would make the enemies it kills drop  Scorched Souls, a pickup that increases  Max Health and  Might.
## Levels
Dominus Anger has 6 levels. At max level, Dominus Anger has +40 Base Damage, +50% Speed, +2 Amount, and -1.0 second of Cooldown.
| Level | Description
| Level 1 | Fires a penetrating projectile. Drains health.
| Level 2 | Base Speed up by 50%.
| Level 3 | Base Damage up by 20.
| Level 4 | Fires 2 more projectiles.
| Level 5 | Base Damage up by 20.
| Level 6 | Cooldown reduced by 1 second.

Dominus Hatred is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be picked up from in the area of the Ode to Castlevania stage. It is unlocked by upgrading it to level 6. It is one of the starting weapons of  Barlowe [DLC].
Its union is  Power of Sire [DLC], which also requires  Dominus Anger [DLC] and  Dominus Agony [DLC] at max level.
## Effects
Dominus Hatred fires a beam to the sky which also deals damage, then drops green projectiles from the top of the screen that can pierce through enemies. This weapon drain 1 health per activation, but will not kill the player's character if they have 1 health left.
Dominus Hatred has a 1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every second by the same projectile. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Levels
Dominus Hatred has 6 levels. At max level, Dominus Hatred has +20 Base Damage, +30% Area, +50% Projectile Speed, +2 Amount, +15 Pierce, and -1.0 second of Cooldown.

| Level 4 | Base Area up by 30%. Passes through 3 more enemies.
| Level 5 | Fires 2 more projectiles. Passes through 4 more enemies.
| Level 6 | Cooldown reduced by 1 seconds. Passes through 5 more enemies.

The Dragon Water Whip is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Trevor Belmont. It is unlocked by Surviving 10 minutes as  Trevor Belmont.
Its Evolution is the  Hydrostormer Tip, which requires the  Attractorb. Evolving it unlocks  Grant Danasty as playable character.
As a magic whip, it can be picked from  Morning Star.
## Effects
The Dragon Water Whip is a whip that strikes in a forward direction of where the character is facing, spawning more with a high Amount (up to 8, as it will strike in 8 directions). Unlike the Alchemy Whip, the Dragon Water Whip will not attack forward, up-forward, then down-forward, but will instead attack in a clockwise or counter-clockwise pattern depending on the direction the character faces. Every 7th activation of this whip shoots out a snaking dragon projectile (affected by Area, but not Amount) that penetrates all enemies and walls to deal damage.
## Arcanas
-  Jail of Crystal (XIV) - The Dragon Water Whip's whip attacks and dragon projectile freezes enemies on hit. This chance is affected by Luck.
-  Slash (XVI) - Allows the Dragon Water Whip to critical hit. Its critical hits deal 4x damage and have a 10% chance to occur. This chance is affected by Luck.

Dust to Dust is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Incineration and max level  Candelabrador. It can alternatively be unlocked in the  Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "cradledineternity".
## Effects
Dust to Dust retains similar behavior to  Incineration. When Dust to Dust's wave of ash reaches the edge of the screen, it will rebound in the opposite direction, erasing enemies in its path as it continues to grow in size.
Compared to Incineration, Dust to Dust has -20% Area, +0.2 seconds of Duration, +0.5 seconds of Cooldown, +0.1 seconds of Repeat Interval, and +95 Pool Limit.
Dust to Dust deals  Hell damage.
- Much like Incineration, Dust to Dust is bugged to not have the "HELL" tag when applicable.
Dust to Dust has a 0.05 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 0.5 seconds by the same wave of ash. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.

The Eagle Gun is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the second optional starting weapon of  Formina Franklyn as well as the starting weapon for the  Kugutsu "Boh" skin. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the  Pendragon, which requires the  Spinach and Falconfire tech. Fully evolving it (into max level  Pendragon) unlocks  Diva No. 5 as playable character.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from  Intuition.
## Effects
Eagle Gun locks on nearby enemies with cursors and fires at them. Amount affects the max number of locking cursors. Ignores: Duration.
Can glimmer the "Falconfire" tech, which generates a large explosion around the closest foe.
## Arcanas
-  Sapphire Mist (I) - Eagle Gun has a chance to fire more than twice.

Ebony Diabologue is a weapon selector from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It becomes available at the start of a stage when unlocked and equipped by an eligible character. It allows the player to select one of the Ode to Castlevania ambiguous powers, which includes:
-  Confodere
-  Optical Shot
-  Sonic Dash
-  Luminatio
-  Umbra
-  Globus
-  Dextro Custos,  Sinestro Custos and  Centralis Custos
-  Dominus Anger,  Dominus Hatred and  Dominus Agony
-  Summon Spirit,  Dark Rift,  Sword Brothers, and  Soul Steal (once unlocked)
## Unlocking
The Ebony Diabologue is unlocked by evolving all 8 glyph lines that can be evolved, which refers to all the weapons above except  Summon Spirit,  Dark Rift,  Sword Brothers, and  Soul Steal. This does not have to be done in a single run.
## Eligible characters
Note that not of all eligible characters have an ambiguous power as starting weapon.

Ebony Wings is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Exdash Exiviiq. It is unlocked by getting Peachone to Level 7.
Its union is  Vandalier, which also requires  Peachone at max level.
## Effects
Ebony Wings is a bird that flies around the player and bombards a circling zone with projectiles. The zone revolves counterclockwise around the player. The bird moves behind the player at a slower speed, but the bombarding circle will always stay in a position relative to the player.
By default, Ebony Wings fires 4 sets of 4 projectiles. Each set fires all of its projectiles at about the same spot, set by the position of the visible zone at the instant that set starts. A set firing is on a different timer to the zone being active, so the first set can start firing up to a second after the zone lights up. This means that the number of sets per activation can vary by 1.
 Duration increases the time bombards are active, with 1 second roughly equal to 1 set by default.  Area increases the Area-of-Effect of the projectiles, but not the size of the bombarding circle itself.  Speed increases how fast the circle moves.  Amount increases how many projectiles are fired per set.  Cooldown bonuses reduce the time between each activation, the time between each set of projectiles, and the time between each projectile within a set.  Move Speed improves Ebony Wings's movement but has virtually no effect on its capability.
## Arcanas
-  Gemini (I) - Creates counterpart  Zhar Ptytsia. It levels up as Ebony Wings does and benefits from Limit Breaking. Its bombardment area is slightly further than Ebony Wings's.
-  Twilight Requiem (II) - Allows Ebony Wing's projectiles to explode when they expire. Damage is based on Curse.
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Bombarding zone now locks on nearest enemy. Gains  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.
## Levels
Ebony Wings has 8 levels. At max level, Ebony Wings has +20 Base Damage, +120% Area, +7 Amount, and -0.5 seconds of Cooldown.

## Tips
- Ebony Wings benefits the most from  Cooldown and  Duration bonuses, increasing the active duration and attacking more often when so.
- Ebony Wings should not be considered a main damage dealer, but rather supplementary damage. It works the best in large crowds of enemies. The projectiles have infinite pierce.
- Ebony Wings has an interesting interaction with  Chaos in the Dark Night (V), where every 10 seconds the circular zone slows down, stops, changes direction, then accelerates rapidly, and every 10 seconds starting :05 its speed doubles and halves alternately, in total causing its speed to increase every 20 seconds.
## Trivia
-  Move Speed used to increase the bombarding circles' speed, like  Speed. However, this was not intended and was fixed eventually.
- Ebony Wings's zone circles counterclockwise, which is the opposite of  Peachone.
- This weapon is inspired by the sub-weapon version of Suzaku from the Castlevania series. The attack pattern is similar to the Item Crash of Cardinal, Red Bird.
- The item's name is a reference to the theme "Ebony Wings" from Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia.

Echo Night is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Summon Night, requiring  Duplicator at max level.
## Effects
Echo Night summon claws above and below the character alternatively from the top and bottom of the screen, leaving behind a lingering damage zone of dark clouds.
Echo Night gains more Base Damage, becomes slightly longer, and gets a much shorter  Cooldown. However,  Amount is lowered by one (but then doubled),  Duration reverts back to being ungraded, and Hitbox Delay is slightly longer.
 Area extends how far down the claws reach.
Echo Night has a 0.5 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every second by the same dark cloud. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.

Eight The Sparrow is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.3.2. It is one of the starting weapons of  Pugnala Provola. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes as Pugnala Provola.
Its union is  Phieraggi, which requires both  Phiera Der Tuphello at max level and  Tirajisú.
## Effects
Eight The Sparrow shoots a circular blue energy bullet toward each of the four corners of the screen. Each bullet can initially hit one enemy before dissipating. The bullets cannot pass through walls.
Each point in Amount grants an additional bullet in all four directions.
## Arcanas
-  Gemini (I) - Creates counterpart  Twice Upon a Time. It levels up as Eight The Sparrow does and the angles it shoots at is slightly more vertical, but does not benefit from Limit Breaking.
-  Iron Blue Will (VII) - Allows Eight The Sparrow's projectiles to bounce off of enemies once, occasionally have infinite pierce, and pass through walls. Upon bouncing, the bullet completely reverses its horizontal and vertical speed returning to the direction it came from.
-  Out of Bounds (XII) - When paired with Jail of Crystal (XIV), enemies frozen by Eight The Sparrow's projectiles will explode.
-  Jail of Crystal (XIV) - Gives Eight The Sparrow a 25% chance to freeze enemies. This chance is affected by Luck.
-  Crystal Cries (XII) - When paired with Jail of Crystal (XIV), enemies frozen by Eight The Sparrow's projectiles will drop Crystalized Souls when killed.
## Levels
Eight The Sparrow has 8 levels. At max level, Eight The Sparrow has +10 Base Damage, +50% Projectile Speed, +2 Amount, and +6 Pierce.
| Level | Description
| Level 1 | Fires quickly in four fixed directions.
| Level 2 | Fires 1 more projectile.
| Level 3 | Passes through 2 more enemies.
| Level 4 | Fires 1 more projectile.
| Level 5 | Base Damage up by 5.
| Level 6 | Passes through 2 more enemies.
| Level 7 | Base Damage up by 5. Base Speed up by 50%.
| Level 8 | Passes through 2 more enemies.

## Tips
- Eight The Sparrow already has low Cooldown, and having more Cooldown reduction can turn the weapon into a stream of bullets, especially when combined with Phiera Der Tuphello.
- By moving in a single direction, with high Pierce and Amount, bullets can stay on screen forever. It can have relatively high damage per second on group control.
## Trivia
- Eight The Sparrow, along with Phiera Der Tuphello and Phieraggi have values in the attributes of "critChance" and "critMul" like any other weapons that can deal critical damage, but they do not have the ability.
- This weapon is very similar to Knife, both can deal critical hits by default, level ups increase base damage by 10, with focuses on Amount and Pierce. They also fire in relatively fixed directions.
- It is similar to a joke song written by Italian comic duo "Lillo & Greg", "otto il passerotto", literally translated as "eight the little Sparrow". It may also be an English pun as "ate the sparrow".
- The pronunciation of the name resembles the Italian phrase "e io ti sparo", literally meaning "and i shoot you".
- This weapon may be inspired by the bullets from the Touhou Project series. With the sheer amount comparable to what the enemies from that series spawn, circular blue bullet on the edge and fading into white in the middle.
- Coincidentally, the eighth game in the Touhou Project series, Imperishable Night, contains a boss character that is a sparrow.

Embrace of Gaea is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.13. It is the evolution of  Gaze of Gaea, and requires  Parm Aegis. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
## Effects
Embrace of Gaea creates a stationary, spinning green circle that rapidly deals damage. Embrace of Gaea can deal retaliatory damage. It gains a bonus to Base Damage,  Area,  Duration, and a lower Interval, but loses the  Amount and has a longer  Cooldown.
It has a 5% chance to defang enemies, which is affected by  Luck.
Its Base Damage is doubled when the character is invulnerable.
Embrace of Gaea has a 0.3 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 0.3 second by the same zone. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Arcanas
-  Divine Bloodline (IX) - Allows Embrace of Gaea to increase  Max Health by 0.5 when enemies are killed by its retaliatory damage.

The Emerald Rapture is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC in Vampire Survivors.
Its Evolution is the  Emerald Wave, which requires the  Crown. It is unlocked by evolving it.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from  Intuition.
## Obtaining
The Emerald Rapture drops from the boss in The Junction, the  Psychic Ogre. The player must use a flying character or clip out of bounds to reach this boss.
Alternatively, the Emerald Rapture can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "followfate".
## Effects
The Emerald Rapture summons green curved lines that "teleport" (instantly kill) enemies , but they might not drop experience gems. 
The chance to reward experience, at base, is 45%. This chance is unaffected by  Luck. Every level of the weapon will increase the chance to reward experience by 5%.
Enemies with instant kill resistance, and bosses holding a  Treasure Chest, will instead take normal damage. 
Note that, despite the description, Emerald Rapture is only affected by  Might,  Duration, and  Cooldown.
## Levels
The Emerald Rapture has 8 levels. At max level, the Emerald Rapture has a 35% better chance at leaving XP intact, and strikes much more often.

Emergency Meeting is an evolved weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Report!, requiring  Mini Crewmate at max level.
## Effects
Emergency Meeting emits a cone of soundwaves in the direction the player is moving or last moved. It also periodically chooses a random type of normal enemy on-screen to "vote out" and instantly destroys them.
Once a player in Co-op mode died, walking over the dead body triggers a Rosary effect as the character lies sideways, a skull in a bubble above them, and the words "Dead Body Reported" displayed over a red flame-like flash.
Emergency Meeting gains a small increase in Base Damage and an increase in Projectile Speed.

## Tips
- Bats Bats Bats' followers are considered as teammates, once they die their coffin can be used to report the dead body to trigger the screen nuke. Since more can be spawned as Revivals are used up and each one can respawn after a while, they can use Emergency Meeting very effectively.
- Outer Saboteur might display different interactions depending on the circumstances, it will be shown as ejected if you haven't evolved an Ante Chamber weapon, (which changes to dead body reported if playing as an Ante Chamber character).
## Trivia
- Emergency Meeting is based on the mechanic of emergency meeting in Among Us, where the player can press the emergency button to call a meeting immediately to stop and discuss an imminent crisis, or share vital but non urgent information (like who has been proven to be safe) when it is still relatively peaceful.

Endo Gears is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors
Its union is  Clock Tower, which requires  Myo Lift,  Peri Pendulum, and  Epi Head at max level.
## Effects
Endo Gears summons spinning golden gears on the ground that damage enemies they contact, with its damage being increased by  Amount and found  Orologion. Being a Clockwork weapon, Endo Gears also triggers other Clockwork weapons.
- Endo Gears gains a +(1/3)x damage multiplier per +1 Amount, up to a max of x3.333... at +10 Amount
- Endo Gears gains a damage bonus in accordance to log(OrologionsFound), meaning they gain +1 Damage for every 10x in Orologions found, starting with +1 Base Damage at 10 Orologions.
Endo Gears has a 0.5 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every half a second by the same gear. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Arcanas
- Out of Bounds (XII) - Increases the likelihood of finding Orologions, which increase the Endo Gears' damage.
- Hail from the Future (X) - Occasionally spawns Orologions whenever the character levels up, indirectly increasing Endo Gears' damage.

Endo Gears has 9 levels. At level 9, Endo Gears has +10 Base Damage, +40% Area, +30% Speed, and -1.5 seconds of Cooldown.

Epi Head is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors
Its union is  Clock Tower, which requires  Endo Gears,  Myo Lift, and  Peri Pendulum at max level.
## Effects
Epi Head summons heads that travel across the screen in a wavy path from one side to the other, piercing all enemies and dealing damage, with its damage being increased by  Amount and found  Orologion. Being a Clockwork weapon, Epi Head triggers all other Clockwork weapons.
- Epi Head gains a +(1/3)x damage multiplier per +1 Amount, up to a max of x3.333... at +10 Amount
- Epi Head gains a damage bonus in accordance to log(OrologionsFound), meaning they gain +1 Damage for every 10x in Orologions found, starting with +1 Base Damage at 10 Orologions.
Epi Head has a 1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every second by the same head. This is reduced to 0.1 seconds at max level so they cannot be hit more often than every tenth of a second. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.

# Evolution
Evolution
Evolving 3 items in one chest. From left to right, the evolutions here are:  Thunder Loop,  Hellfire, and  Soul Eater.
Evolution is a game mechanic in Vampire Survivors that typically transforms a base weapon into a stronger evolved weapon using a passive item as a catalyst. Additionally, there are a few unique categories of evolution that some weapons follow.
- A Union is a combination of two or more weapons. Union weapons share similar characteristics with evolved weapons, except the requisite weapons are merged into one weapon slot after the Union weapon is obtained.
- A Gift is an additional weapon or passive item a player receives when evolution conditions are met, and does not change any required weapons or items. Gifts act as an additional weapon or passive item, without replacing the base weapon.
- A Morph involves a permanent transformation for a specific character, attainable by reaching a high enough level and acquiring certain relics as catalysts. Morphs on this page are specific to weapons that can evolve through morphing specific characters, such as Bone morphing into Anima of Mortaccio alongside Moraccio.
Evolved weapons usually inherit most of the base weapon stats with extra effects. Most Area-of-Effect weapons may add bonus to Area and some have changes on base damage because their behavior is different.
## Mechanics
To acquire an evolution or union, or to obtain a gift, the player needs to fulfill following conditions:
- The player must have a fully leveled base weapon and its counterpart (required level varies by case) in their inventory.
- In case of union, all base weapons must be fully leveled up. This may also require a passive item counterpart.
- In the case of Infinite Corridor, Crimson Shroud, Sole Solution, Ashes of Muspell, and most of the weapons after Version 1.0 and from the DLCs, all related passive items must also be fully leveled.
- In case of Bracelet, Bi-Bracelet, and Super Candybox II Turbo, certain unions, and choices from Penshin Fatcha, a passive item is not needed.
- The player must then collect a Treasure Chest that contains an evolution type reward. In most stages, this kind of chest is dropped by bosses that spawn at or after the 10-minute mark with some exceptions:
- The first chest in Mad Forest dropped by the Glowing Bat, which spawns along the wave at 1:00, can evolve a weapon.
- All chests in Dairy Plant, Il Molise, Cappella Magna, Boss Rash, Laborratory, Abyss Foscari [DLC], and Hectic Highway [DLC] can evolve a weapon regardless of time.
- In Green Acres the ability to evolve a weapon is the same as the wave in its original stage.
- For example, chests dropped by waves from Dairy Plant prior to 10 minute mark can evolve a weapon, but waves from Inlaid Library cannot.
- In Tiny Bridge, all chests, except the chests from minute 3:00 and 6:00 bosses, can evolve a weapon.
- At Mt.Moonspell [DLC], all chests, except the chests from the minute 3:00 and 5:00 bosses, can evolve a weapon.
- The first chest in Lake Foscari [DLC] dropped by the Foscaritrice, which spawns at 2:00, can evolve a weapon.
- In Neo Galuga [DLC], the chest dropped by Metal Alien at 9:00 can evolve a weapon.
- Treasure Chests that contain an Arcana (minutes 11:00 and 21:00 in every normal stage) can only evolve a weapon when the player is already at the max count of Arcana.
- The Character Gyorunton can evolve weapons with any chest pickup that gives an item, regardless of other conditions.
The chest will then grant an evolved weapon as its first reward in place of the usual random upgrade if and only if the evolved weapon is not banished. On evolution, the base weapon is typically removed and the evolved weapon is added, while the passive item remains unaffected. On union, all requisite base weapons are removed and their union is added, reducing the number of occupied weapon slots. Upon obtaining a Gift, the base weapon will not be replaced when the Gift is obtained.
Generally, only one weapon can be evolved per chest, including the higher tier chests. However, some chests contain multiple evolutions.
- The minute 9, 11 and 13 non-Arcana chest drops in Il Molise.
- The minute 10 chests in Dairy Plant, Gallo Tower and Cappella Magna.
- The minute 20 chests in Inlaid Library, Dairy Plant, Gallo Tower, Cappella Magna, and The Bone Zone.
- All chests with an evolution in Bat Country and Tiny Bridge.
- The chests dropped by the Giant Enemy Crab, Drowner, and Stalker.
Chests in Il Molise, Bat Country, and Tiny Bridge, and the chest from Giant Enemy Crab can evolve up to five weapons. The rest can evolve up to three. To evolve multiple weapons at once, these chests must be of the higher tier with enough rewards, as evolution is a type of reward.
When playing in Co-op, weapons are capable of evolution regardless of which player has the Passive Weapon and which player has the Active Weapon, so long as the requirements are met and the share passives option in the level select menu is enabled.
## Morph
Certain weapons evolve automatically when a character morphs into a new form, which occurs once the player has met the required conditions and, for base game characters, obtained the necessary relic.
When a base game character morphs, their starting weapon evolves into a new weapon as well, and picking up a chest is not required. However, for DLC characters, morphing does not evolve their starting weapon.
In the base game, only Mortaccio, Yatta Cavallo, Bianca Ramba, and O'Sole Meeo can morph with certain weapons.
## Gift
Under certain conditions, a new item is either granted automatically, added to the level-up pool, or found in a chest.

## Trivia
- With the addition of  Vicious Hunger,  Shadow Pinion, and  Valkyrie Turner in patch 0.5.2, all passive items at the time have an evolution.
- With the addition of  Silver Ring,  Gold Ring,  Metaglio Left, and  Metaglio Right in patch 0.6.1, all base weapons, except bouncy weapons, have an evolution.
-  Torrona's Box, added in patch 0.7.2, was not used for any evolution until the introduction of  Sole Solution, added in patch 0.11.0.
- It is also the only passive item that is involved with more than one evolution in the base v1.0 version of the game.
-  Bone is the first base game bouncy/rare weapon to get an evolution, with a unique way to evolve by obtaining a Chaos relic, and leveling the original weapon owner to level 80 to morph them. Making the characters themselves stronger and evolving their starting weapon at the same time.
-  SpellStrom is the first ever three-weapon union.
-  Clock Tower is the first four-weapon union.
-  Alucard Shield can technically absorb all the evolved weapons into it, acting like a union. However, it is not classified as a union, but a gift.
- Emergency Meeting is the first DLC that uses only DLC items to evolve weapons.
- Each passive item in Emergency Meeting resembles the character that uses the base weapon.
- Ante Chamber is the second one to do so.
- With the addition of  Gaze of Gaea and  Magi-Stone, both of the new passive items that got integrated early for the Ode to Castlevania DLC,  Parm Aegis and  Karoma's Mana, can be properly unlocked without using  Arma Dio in their respective update as they are used for the evolution of a new weapon.
- As of 1.14, all evolutions from v1.0 that are not already a union, or use Yellow Sign stage items or Torrona's Box to evolve can be united with another weapon. Although most of them are exclusive to the Ode to Castlevania DLC.
- If the player has a secondary character and different characters end up having the weapon and the passive item necessary for the evolution, you will still be able to evolve the weapon.

Familiar Forge is a weapon selector from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It allows the player to select one of the Ode to Castlevania familiars. It is the starting weapon of  Young Maria Renard.
## Effects
Familiar Forge opens a list of Familiars (Familiar or Innocent Devil) to pick. Once picked, they will be summoned as secondary character, having their own weapons, sharing passive effects of the character, and acts independently depending on behavior. Familiars won't be removed from the list when selected, allowing multiples of the same familiar to be chosen.
Additionally, when a Familiar is obtained Ode to Castlevania pickups for the character are enabled and can be obtained from light sources.
## Unlocking
Once  Black Disk is obtained, the Familiar Forge will occur in Ode To Castlevania stage, in the aqueduct biome. It is unlocked by picking it up.
Alternatively, the Familiar Forge can be unlocked by playing  Hector and selecting it as his guaranteed 4th level up option offered every 7 levels so long as valid weapon or passive weapon level up choices remain.

| | Imp | Trident (level 8) | Stays close to enemies.
| | Wood Rod | Fire Wand (level 2), Lightning Ring (level 2), Magic Wand (level 2) | Follows the character's moving path.

Festive Winds is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Silver Wind, requiring  Pummarola at max level.
Its evolution is  Argent Flow which requires max level  Torrona's Box.
## Effects
Festive Winds fires sparkling leaf-shaped energy orbs that travel around the character in an oval-like pattern. The orbs are positioned relative to the character, and follow the character's movement.
Festive Winds'  Speed is increased but  Duration is lowered.
 Area affects the orb's size and how far away from the player they travel.
Festive Winds lowers the defenses of the enemies; as the underlying mechanic, it just applies a damage multiplier debuff to them. If the enemy's debuff resistance is less than 2, each hit increases damage taken by 2% additively, up to a maximum of 100x damage with 5,000 hits.
Festive Winds has a 0.5 second Hitbox Delay, limiting the number of hits per second that any single enemy can receive (to two). Note that, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
Festive Winds has a 5% chance to generate little hearts that heal 1 point of health upon killing an enemy. This chance is affected by  Luck.
## Arcanas
-  Sarabande of Healing (VI) allows Festive Winds' little hearts to heal 2 points of health and trigger a pulse dealing the same amount of damage.
-  Twilight Requiem (II) allows the orbs to explode when they expire.

Fibonacci Spritz is a weapon from the Ante Chamber DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Canio [DLC]. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its evolution is  Royal Flush [DLC], which requires  Outer Saboteur [DLC] at max level.
## Effects
Fibonacci Spritz fires a seltzer in the faced direction, which sprays fizzy water and spirals out of the screen, and has a chance to fire a random equipped weapon. This chance is 0% at base, increasing with each level of the weapon up to a max of 34%. Instead of being multiplied by the player's  Luck bonus, this chance is affected by Luck by directly adding one tenth of the character's Luck bonus to it.
Fibonacci Spritz has a 1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every second by the same spray. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Levels
Fibonacci Spritz has 9 levels. At max level, Fibonacci Spritz has +15 Base Damage, +20% Area, +2 Amount, -0.6 seconds of Cooldown, and a 34% chance to fire another equipped weapon.
| Level 1 | Creates a spiral spray of fizzy water. Has a chance to fire another equipped weapon.

| Level 4 | Base Damage up by 5. 3% chance to fire another weapon.
| Level 5 | Base Area up by 20%. 5% chance to fire another weapon.

| Level 7 | Base Damage up by 5. 13% chance to fire another weapon.

| Level 9 | Base Damage up by 5. 34% chance to fire another weapon.

## Tips
- Fibonacci Spritz pairs extremely well with weapons with high cooldowns, such as  Troll Bomb [DLC] and  Pentagram due to its ability to trigger these weapons more often.
- When paired with  Paranormal Scan [DLC], the player can be granted an unfathomable amount of stats.
- Fibonacci Spritz is best with low numbers of weapons, since it can only trigger one random weapon with each firing.
- This weapon pairs exceptionally well with  Sapphire Mist (I), as not only will Fibonacci Spritz trigger other weapons more often, since it itself is triggering multiple times, but the weapons it triggers also have chance to trigger multiple times, effectively quadrupling the number of triggers.
## Trivia
- The Fibonacci Spritz is a reference to both the Fibonacci and Seltzer joker from Balatro, as it moves in a Fibonacci spiral and has an additional chance of retriggering equipped weapons, much like how the Seltzer functions in its original game.
- The chance for this weapon to fire a random equipped weapon, being 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, and 34, are all Fibonacci numbers.

Fire Wand is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Arca Ladonna,  Wood Rod [DLC], and  Gaibon [DLC]. It is unlocked by destroying a total of 20 light sources.
Its evolution is  Hellfire, which requires  Spinach.
## Effects
Fire Wand shoots an arc of fireballs in the direction of a random enemy.
Fireballs are fired near simultaneously and additional ones gained through  Amount bonuses are added to the ends of the arc of fireballs. The fireballs cannot pass through walls. Each fireball can hit one enemy before dissipating.
## Arcanas
-  Waltz of Pearls (XI) - Allows Fire Wand's projectiles to bounce off enemies up to three times.
-  Heart of Fire (XIX) - Allows Fire Wand's projectiles to explode upon contact with an enemy, dealing half its base damage in an area.
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Fire Wand aims at nearest enemy, and gains  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.
-  Heir of Fate (XIX) - Enemies defeated by Fire Wand will drop  Scorched Souls, giving bonus  Max Health and  Might.
## Levels
Fire Wand has 8 levels. At max level, Fire Wand has +70 Base Damage and +60% Speed.

## Tips
- The fireballs are very slow, which means if they aim at an enemy that is far away, the enemy may be out of the way of the fireball before they are hit. This can be alleviated with  Bracer, the Speed PowerUp, and leveling up the weapon.
- Since the fireballs are aimed randomly, they are not a reliable source of damage. It is better to use Fire Wand as a supplemental weapon rather than a main damage dealer, or at least to have a weapon you can direct damage with in case it is uncooperative.

Fire-L3GS is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Firearm, requiring  Weapon Power-Up and  Candelabrador.
## Effects
Fire-L3GS releases a wave of flame particles which starts in an arch around the player before straightening out as it moves further away. Unlike  Firearm, which shoots at the nearest enemy, Fire-L3GS fires in the direction that the player is moving or last moved. Projectiles pierce through enemies.
When a Fire-L3GS projectile destroys a Light source or any other type of destructible stage item, a wave of fire will be released in the direction of the player, passing through them and continuing to the edges of the screen.
## Arcanas
-  Heir of Fate (XIX) - The  Fire damage from this weapon would make the enemies it kills drop  Scorched Souls, a pickup that increases  Max Health and  Might.
## Limit Break
With Limit Break, Fire-L3GS can be further leveled up.
| Description | Rarity | Max Total
| Might +0.5% | 10 | -
| Area +2.5% | 10 | 1000%
| Speed +5% | 10 | 200%
| Amount +1 | 1 | 10
| Duration +100ms | 1 | 3.0 seconds
## Tips
- Pairing Fire-L3GS with  Greatest Jubilee is a powerful combo, as the light sources spawned by it also trigger the fire waves. As such, when Greatest Jubilee activates, it can cause an almost omnidirectional fire wave.
- Stages with more types of destructible items, such as the  Stained Glass in Cappella Magna and the  Dairy Cart in Dairy Plant, are ideal for using Fire-L3GS. The best stage for the weapon is probably Gallo Tower, as the traps summon a large number of light sources which trigger the fire waves.
