Pocket Knife is a weapon introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Genya Arikado and  Fake Grant. It can be purchased (and unlocked) from  Master Librarian [DLC] for 2,800.
Its evolution is  Claimh Solais, which requires  Torrona's Box at max.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from  Spectral Sword.
## Effects
Pocket Knife throws short-ranged projectiles in the faced direction. The number of projectiles thrown is affected by  Amount, and all projectiles are thrown at once. At base, Pocket Knife has no pierce, and projectiles will expire immediately upon hitting an enemy.
## Arcanas
-  Slash (XVI) - Allows for Pocket Knife to critical hit. Critical chance is affected by  Luck.
## Levels
Pocket Knife has 8 levels. At max level, Pocket Knife has +15 Base Damage, +3 Amount, +3 Pierce, and -0.2 seconds of Cooldown.

Power Of Lire is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of  Soul Steal [DLC] at max level and  Vicious Hunger.
The  Master Librarian [DLC] starts with it as a hidden weapon.
## Effects
Power of Lire will periodically trigger a Gold Fever and pulse several times based on  Amount. With each pulse, most enemies and pickups, including  Experience, on the screen will instantly be deleted and turned into bags of money of different colors, which are then magnetized toward the player. The bags of money are a different sprite from the  Coin Bag or the  Rich Coin Bag, yet they do not appear in the Collection. Then, the Gold Fever continues as normal. While this cannot instantly kill certain enemies, such as the Atlanteans guarding the Yellow Sign stage items, it will still deal a large amount of damage to them with each pulse, equaling one tenth of the Gold the player has accumulated during that run.
Compared to  Soul Steal, Power of Lire has decreased  Amount and a slower Interval, and loses the ability to spawn Little Hearts.
Unlike most weapons, Power of Lire cannot be upgraded further with Limit Break.

## Trivia
- Power of Lire was exclusively available to  Master Librarian [DLC] as a hidden weapon until the Ode to Castlevania expansion update came out, in which it becomes a union of  Soul Steal [DLC] and  Vicious Hunger.
- The coin bags spawned from Power of Lire are almost the same as the ones in Castlevania: Symphony of the Night.
- Power of Lire might be a pun on Power of Sire, and the obsoleted currency of Italy, the lira.
- Its icon features the official abbreviation of the Italian lira, LIT, and likely references the modern, yet slightly out-of-fashion, meaning of "lit" meaning "cool".
- The face appearing when Power of Lire triggers is the one from Maria Montessori, specifically the portrait appearing in the 1000 Italian lire bill.

Power of Sire is a weapon union from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of  Dominus Anger [DLC],  Dominus Hatred [DLC], and  Dominus Agony [DLC].
## Effects
Upon obtaining Power of Sire,  Dominus Anger [DLC],  Dominus Hatred [DLC], and  Dominus Agony [DLC], will be converted to hidden weapons, or granted as such at max level, recoloring their projectiles to appear burgundy. These weapons will also fire twice as fast, if applicable.
In addition, Power of Sire will activate a screen-wide insta-kill attack every 30 seconds. This effect lasts for 7 seconds and can not occur more than every 0.33 seconds. During this effect, the map will be completely obscured and a figure resembling  Vlad Tepes Dracula, will appear, conceal the player character under his cloak, and emit a burgundy mist that damages all enemies on screen. The player character becomes Invulnerable for the duration of this effect.
Power of Sire retains the health drain of its components:
- Dominus Anger and Hatred drain a max of 4 health per activation, decreasing as the player's health reaches 25%. At this point, they only drain 1 health.
- Dominus Agony drains health equal to (3+PlayerLevel)*HealthPercentage. This means that the weapon will drain more health as the player levels up, but will drain less as their Health gets lower.
Unlike most weapons, Power of Sire can not be Limit Broken. However, any Limit Break levels accumulated on the Dominus weapons will be saved, but no more can be added.

Prism Lass is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Probotector. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Probotector.
Its evolution is  Time Warp, which requires  Weapon Power-Up and  Wings.
## Effects
Prism Lass fires a blade shaped projectile in the direction that the player is moving or last moved. The blade will slice through all enemies in its path, performing a large slash at the end of it. Both the initial projectile and slash can increase in  Area, and the projectile's travel distance is determined by  Speed.  Amount affects how many projectiles are fired at once, with every second projectile being fired in the opposite direction that the player is facing. 
When playing as Probotector, the projectiles will use a blue tinted version of his melee attack animation, it will only be a blue blade with other characters.
Upon hitting an enemy, Prism Lass has a 5% chance to freeze them. This chance is affected by  Luck.
## Arcana
-  Jail of Crystal (XIV) - Increases the chance to freeze enemies to 25%. This chance is affected by  Luck.
-  Gemini (I) - Creates counterpart  Prism Damsel. It fires projectiles mirroring Prism Lass, and levels up as Prism Lass does but does not benefit from Limit Breaking. It also benefits from Jail of Crystal (XIV).
## Levels
Prism Lass has 8 Levels. At max level, Prism Lass has +20 Base Damage, +20% Area, +20% Speed, +1 Amount, -1.0 second of Cooldown, 5% chance to freeze enemies.

## Tips
- As freeze chance only increases to 5%, it is recommended to pick up  Luck bonuses such as  Clover,  Little Clover, and  Wicked Season (XIII).
-  Jail of Crystal (XIV) increases the freeze chance to 25%, making it a must have if the player wants to make the most out of the freezing effect.
- Thanks to its unique firing pattern of sending every second projectile backwards, Prism Lass is best paired with an even  Amount in order to maximize damage in both directions.
## Trivia
- Prism Lass and  Icebrand are the only weapons with the innate ability to freeze enemies which are affected by  Jail of Crystal (XIV). Instead of gaining the ability, they instead gain an increased chance.
- In the code, it is shown that the "Lass" in its name is short for Cutlass, the type of weapon it is.

Prismatic Missile is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Luminaire Foscari [DLC].
Its evolution is  Luminaire [DLC], which requires  Crown at max level.
## Effects
Prismatic Missile spawns a ring of rainbow missiles from the top of the screen then spiral down and around the character's present location (track behind the character when moving), which later explodes with rainbow-colored dust. They can add the explosions of  Twilight Requiem (II),  Jail of Crystal (XIV), or  Heart of Fire (XIX) (Bug: Should only apply the first chosen Arcana, but will only apply the last if the Arcana are obtained before).
## Arcanas
-  Heart of Fire (XIX) - Allows the missile to explode upon contact with an enemy, dealing half its base damage in an area.
-  Jail of Crystal (XIV) - Gives the missile a 25% chance to freeze enemies. This chance is affected by  Luck.
-  Twilight Requiem (II) - Allows the missile to explode again when it hits the ground. Extra explosion's damage is affected by  Curse.
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Aims at nearest enemy instead of character, and gains  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.

Profusione D'Amore is a morph from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.7.0. It is the evolution of  Celestial Dusting, and requires  Chaos Altemanna relic and reaching level 80 while playing as  O'Sole Meeo.
Alternatively, it can be obtained via Cosmic Finger rewards from  Gold Fingers, or the Edition of  O'Sole Meeo's  Survarot.
## Effects
Profusione D'Amore fires flowers away from the character's walking direction that bounce off of walls and obstacles, but pierce through an unlimited number of enemies. As they reach the end of their  Duration, they slow down and shed petals in a small X shape, dealing additional damage to nearby enemies. Profusione D'Amore starts a petal effect after a normal attack, then sends out water waves with flowers across the entire screen on the next attack. It deals around four and a half times the damage compared to the normal flowers. These waves pick a random point to start propagating.
Profusione D'Amore has a slower  Speed, and its Interval is removed spawning all the flowers at once.
 Move Speed increases its overall spawn rate when moving, when the character stops it initiates the default  Cooldown. Profusione D'Amore ignores Projectile Speed bonuses outside of its level ups.
Profusione D'Amore has a 0.3 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 0.3 seconds by the same flower. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
Profusione D'Amore gains a 66%[Verify] chance to generate a  Little Heart when an enemy is defeated. This chance is unaffected by  Luck.
It causes O'Sole Meeo to visually transform into a dancing sun god surrounded by flowers. If a character other than O'Sole gets the weapon, a translucent, transformed O'Sole appears behind the character.
## Arcanas
-  Sarabande of Healing (VI) - Allows Profusione D'Amore's Little Hearts to heal 2 points of health and trigger a pulse dealing the same amount of damage.
-  Twilight Requiem (II) - Allows the flowers to explode when they expire. The explosions also have the same chance to generate Little Hearts. Damage is based on  Curse.

## Trivia
- Profusione D'Amore is a reference to the 2006 action-adventure game Ōkami, in which a white wolf goddess and main protagonist Amaterasu leaves grass and flowers behind her as she walks and runs.
- One of the objectives of the game is to restore the Guardian Sapling using Bloom to rid of the curse that plagues the land of Nippon, clearing the way for that area to move forward in the game. It is accompanied by a gorgeous cutscene where the leaves of the Guardian Sapling spread out, and the curse is lifted with a pulse of green energy spreading out across the area. As the energy moves across the land, it is rejuvenated as flowers blooms on the pulse while body of water like rivers or seas are cleared as curved water waves splashes out. The petals spreading out and both aspects of the recovery are referenced with the two stages of petals covering the full screen and the screen clear attack animation.
- Profusione D'Amore literally translates to "Profusion of Love" in Italian, a reference to the song "Love Profusion" from the 2003 album American Life by Madonna.

Prototype A is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Long Gun, requiring  Weapon Power-Up.
## Effects
Prototype A changes the main weapon's attack into a helix of projectiles, granting it much larger damage output and area coverage. Just like its unevolved form,  Amount decreases the weapon's cooldown rather than adding more projectiles. 
Alongside it, 2 jet drones are summoned that aim exactly like the main weapon, floating slightly behind the character and shooting the exact same projectiles as the  Long Gun. These drones do not scale with  Amount, and always fire on minimum cooldown. 
## Arcanas
-  Iron Blue Will (VII) - Allows the projectiles from Prototype A's drones to bounce off enemies up to three times, occasionally have infinite Pierce, and pass through walls.
-  Heart of Fire (XIX) - Allows Prototype A's projectiles to explode upon contact with an enemy, dealing half its base damage in an area.
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Base weapon (not the drones) aims at the nearest enemy, and gains  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.

-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Base weapon (not the drones) aims at the nearest enemy, and gains  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.

The Punch is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is one of the two starting weapons of  Bonnie Blair as well as the starting weapon for the  Kugutsu "Sukune" skin. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the  Pressure Point, which requires the Raksha tech, and can be further evolved into  Gilded Hand with Shenlong Firefist tech. Fully evolving it unlocks  Kick starting weapon and solo skin for Bonnie Blair.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from  Intuition.
## Effects
Punch attacks in a curved pattern starting from behind the character and going above and below them. Can glimmer the "Raksha" tech, which fires 10 flaming punches a short distance in front of the character in a cone pattern that does not move from the activation location.
## Arcanas
-  Heir of Fate (XIX) - The  Fire damage from this weapon would make the enemies it kills drop  Scorched Souls, a pickup that increases  Max Health and  Might.

Raging Fire is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Charlotte Aulin. It is unlocked by evolving it.
It can be evolved into  Salamender with Max level  Spinach.
As a spell, it can be picked from  Belnades' Spellbook.
## Effects
Being a Belnades' Spellbook weapon, Raging Fire has a charge time before activation, which is indicated by the brightness of its created magic circle.
Raging Fire summons a red magic circle a set distance away from the character's faced direction. Upon reaching half-charge, it locks onto the next enemy it comes in contact with until it activates or until the enemy dies. Once activated, it summons a cluster of spreading flames that heavily damages enemies in its area.
## Arcanas
-  Gemini (I) - Obtains Speculo Raging Fire as counterpart, which mirrors Raging Fire.
-  Heart of Fire (XIX) - Flames explode when touching enemies, dealing massive damage constantly.
-  Heir of Fate (XIX) - The  Fire damage from this weapon would make the enemies it kills drop  Scorched Souls, a pickup that increases  Max Health and  Might.

Refectio is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Mina Hakuba and  Familiar. It is unlocked by evolving it.
Once  Beast Gate is unlocked, Refectio can be dropped by Jiang Shi, the boss enemy located at the top of Cathedral (the top part of the far east building, next to the Clock Tower).
Refectio can be evolved into  Sanctuary with max level  Clover.
As a spell, it can be picked from  Belnades' Spellbook.
## Effects
Being a Belnades' Spellbook weapon, Refectio has a charge time before activation, which is indicated by the brightness of its created magic circle.
Refectio creates a blue magic circle underneath the character. Once activated, it generates a holy zone that damages enemies and heals characters in its area. Amount affects the holy zone's Duration. Its healing is increased by the Recovery stat, with every 1 Recovery adding 1 point of healing.
## Arcanas
-  Gemini (I) - Will create a moving Refectio, matching the player's movement at double the speed.
-  Twilight Requiem (II) - Holy zone creates a wide explosion on expire.
-  Sarabande of Healing (VI) - Doubles Reflectio's healing and triggers a damaging pulse with each heal.

Report! is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Crewmate Dino. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Crewmate.
Report! can be evolved into  Emergency Meeting with  Mini Crewmate at max level. The passive item will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches level 2.
## Effects
Report! emits a cone of soundwaves to the left or right of the character, depending on which direction they are currently facing. These soundwaves will damage and knock back enemies. They cannot be emitted above or below the character, regardless of what direction the player is moving in.
Once a player in Co-op mode dies, walking over the dead body triggers a Rosary effect as the character lies sideways, a skull in a bubble above them, and the words "Dead Body Reported" displayed over a red flame-like flash.
## Levels
Report! has 8 levels. At max level, Report! has +35 Base Damage, +30 Knockback, and -0.6 seconds of Cooldown.

- Bats Bats Bats' followers are considered as teammates, once they die their coffin can be used to report the dead body to trigger the screen nuke. Since more can be spawned as Revivals are used up and each one can respawn after a while, they can use Reported! very effectively.

The Rings of Calamity is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Spirit Rings.
## Effects
Rings of Calamity does not attack directly and instead triggers the "Chaos Disaster" tech. Chaos Disaster summons five orbs that charge up and shoot to the border of the screen dealing screenwide damage. The orbs deal twice the damage of the fullscreen effect.
In addition, Rings of Calamity maintains the effect from Spirit Rings, triggering additional techs when Area, Speed, Duration, and/or Growth bonuses are at or above 155% (+55% on the stats screen). At base it has the Sunlight tech, which summons several light pillars that move around.
Each stat grants a Glimmer tech when it reaches +55%:
- Area grants Vermillion Sands, which summons a red tornado that targets the most powerful enemy in sight.
- Speed grants Heaven's Thunder, which rains a few thunders on foes similar to  Lightning Ring.
- Duration grants Aqua Spheres, which summons a water sphere that bounces around enemies.
- Growth grants Hypergravity, which summons an orb of gravity damages the entire screen.
## Arcanas
-  Heir of Fate (XIX) - The  Fire damage from this weapon would make the enemies it kills drop  Scorched Souls, a pickup that increases  Max Health and  Might.

Road to Heaven is a weapon union from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of  108 Bocce [DLC] and  108 Responsive Prayers [DLC].
## Effects
Road to Heaven will summon tiles, picturing  Menya Moonspell, that wander around the screen, dealing damage to enemies they contact. The damage of these tiles is increased by the difference between  Luck and  Curse, with each difference of 1% increasing the damage the tiles deal by 1%, maxing out at 11x when the difference between Luck and Curse is 1000%.
Occasionally, the tiles will align in a grid and fill up the entire screen, making the player invulnerable for 3 seconds. During this time, the tiles retain their contact damage, and a glow will move across the screen from bottom to top. Enemies hit by this glow will be instantly defeated, unless they possess insta-kill resistance, in which case they will be instead be dealt damage equal to 10x the current damage of Road to Heaven. After each activation, clouds begin to fade in on the edges of the screen. These clouds are purely visual and deal no damage.
After the weapon has activated 24 times, the user will become enlightened. After this point, they are made permanently invulnerable to damage, their level is reset to 1, although they will keep everything they have gained, the level up bar is turned yellow, and the tiles will be permanently arranged, with the aforementioned glow attack happenening at the same interval as before.
- Despite the description stating that 108 activations must occur, Road to Heaven only has to activate 24 times to enlighten the user.
- Also note that extra activations from levelling up Road to Heaven, such as by using Limit Break,  Sapphire Mist (I), or  Fibonacci Spritz [DLC] do not contribute to the activation requirement for enlightenment; the full animation must play 24 times before the user is enlightened.
- Forced activations can stall Road to Heaven's activations due to an interaction between the weapon's special Interval and forced activations, preventing it from activating for long periods of time. Examples of forced activations include:
- Levelling up Road to Heaven
- The passive effects of  Space Dude,  Babi-Onna [DLC],  Menya Moonspell [DLC],  Megalo Menya Moonspell [DLC], and  Jiangshi [DLC]
-  Fibonacci Spritz [DLC]
Road to Heaven has a 1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every second by the same tile. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often. 
## Levels
Road to Heaven has 8 levels. At max level, Road to Heaven provides +90% Luck, -90% Curse, and has -10 seconds of Cooldown and -1 second of Hitbox Delay.

## Tips
- Road to Heaven's level reset synergizes well with characters such as  Queen Sigma and sources of stats-per-level as it allows the user to quickly retrigger level-based effects or gain stats quickly.
- Notably, Arcanas like  Game Killer (0) or  Stake to Your Heart (0), when picked soon before or after the level reset, can maintain the user's low level while allowing them to keep their stats and build. This makes enemies with the HP x Level skill substantially weaker relative to the player past this point.
- Otherwise, with  Hail from the Future (X), the level reset can allow the user to quickly gain a lot of its drops.
- Road to Heaven's +90% Luck bonus synergizes well with weapons that scale on Luck such as  Fibonacci Spritz [DLC] and  Seraphic Cry.
- However, the Curse removal can hurt weapons such as  Sonic Whip [DLC] in the short term.
## Trivia
- Road to Heaven's name is likely a reference to the Led Zeppelin song Stairway to Heaven.
- The animation for the weapon may also reference the move Tenbu Horin from the anime Saint Seiya.

Rock Riot is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Carrie Fernandez. It can be dropped by defeating the Behemoth boss in the north of starting area of the DLC stage. It is unlocked by evolving it.
Rock Riot can be evolved into  Gemma Torpor with Max level  Stone Mask.
As a spell, it can be picked from  Belnades' Spellbook.
## Effect
Being a Belnades' Spellbook weapon, Rock Riot has a charge time before activation, which is indicated by the brightness of its created magic circle.
Rock Riot summons a green magic circle at the top-faced corner of the screen. Once activated, it stops in place and fires multiple rock projectiles downward (affected by Amount) that pierce and damage enemies.
## Arcanas
-  Gemini (I) - Obtains a counterpart of Rock Riot that mirrors it.
-  Waltz of Pearls (XI) - Rock Riot bounces up to 3 times when hitting enemies.

Rocket Science is an evolved weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Science Rocks, requiring  Mini Scientist at max level.
## Effects
Rocket Science displays the order then creates eight blue square buttons in an area around the player. The player can walk over these buttons to detonate them, damaging the enemies in that area multiple times based on Amount. In addition, up to a random selection of five of the eight buttons are numbered one through five. If the player walks over these buttons in ascending order, rocket engines will appear at the top of the screen, blasting enemies with fire in an enormous area.
Rocket Science's Base Damage and Amount has increased, with a slight increase in Interval as well.

Royal Flush is an evolved weapon from the Ante Chamber DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Fibonacci Spritz [DLC], requiring  Outer Saboteur [DLC] at max level.
## Effects
Royal Flush creates a whirlpool filled with the 4 playing card suits around the edge of the screen, occasionally firing a spiral of suits towards the center of the screen. It deals more Base Damage and no longer has an Interval.
This weapon has a 55% chance to fire 1, 2, 3 or 5 other weapons. Instead of being multiplied by the player's  Luck bonus, this chance is affected by Luck by directly adding one tenth of the character's Luck bonus to it. The individual chances to trigger 1, 2, 3, or 5 weapons are 50%, 20%, 20%, and 10%, respectively. This distribution is not affected by Luck.
- A Luck bonus of +450% will guarantee the forced activation.
Upon evolving Fibonacci Spritz into Royal Flush, Outer Saboteur is removed from the passive slot and turns into Inner Saboteur, placed over the character's face and can still evolve other Ante Chamber DLC weapons. Obtaining Royal Flush from a  Super Candybox II Turbo will give the player the option of obtaining Outer Saboteur via a Level Up.

## Tips
- This weapon pairs exceptionally well with  Sapphire Mist (I), as not only will Royal Flush trigger other weapons more often, since it itself is triggering multiple times, but the weapons it triggers also have a chance to trigger multiple times, effectively quadrupling the number of triggers.
- Because of this weapon's high chance to trigger multiple other weapons, it almost completely negates the downside of  Fibonacci Spritz [DLC] only being able to trigger a single weapon at a time.
- However, since it can only trigger up to five weapons at a time, additional weapons granted via  Candybox or  Call of a Mad Moon (XIII) may result in less consistent output.
## Trivia
- Royal Flush is a variant of Straight Flush poker hand that contains an Ace, King, Queen, Jack, and 10, all in the same suit, being the strongest poker hand that can be played with a default poker deck.
- In Balatro, Royal Flush functions the same as a Straight Flush, but has unique achievement/unlockable related with.
- The number of weapons this weapon can trigger, 1, 2, 3, 5, and the chance to trigger them, 55, are all Fibonacci numbers.

Runetracer is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Pasqualina Belpaese. It is unlocked by surviving 5 minutes as Pasqualina Belpaese.
Its evolution is  NO FUTURE, which requires  Armor.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from  Coat of Arms [DLC].
## Effects
Runetracer fires slow-moving diamond-shaped runes in random directions, each has a different color trail. The runes have infinite pierce and bounce off the edges of the screen and obstacles, damaging enemies they hit. Its nature makes it scale up with all stat bonuses well, which also means it needs lots of different stat bonuses to become strong.
Runetracer has a 0.5 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every half a second by the same rune. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses or bounces off a wall, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Arcanas
-  Twilight Requiem (II) - Allows the Runtracer's projectiles to explode when they expire. Damage is based on Curse.
-  Jail of Crystal (XIV) - Gives Runetracer a 25% chance to freeze enemies. This chance is affected by Luck.
-  Out of Bounds (XII) - When paired with Jail of Crystal (XIV), enemies frozen by the Runetracer's projectiles will explode.
-  Crystal Cries (XII) - When paired with Jail of Crystal (XIV), enemies frozen by the Runetracer's projectiles will drop Crystalized Souls when killed.
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Runetracer aims at nearest enemy instead of in random directions, and gains  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.
## Levels
Runetracer has 8 levels. At max level, Runetracer has +20 Base Damage, +40% Projectile Speed, +2 Amount, and +1 second to Duration.

| Level 5 | Base Damage up by 5. Base Speed up by 20%.

| Level 7 | Fires 1 more projectile.

The Saber Machine Gun is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is one of the two optional starting weapons of  Formina Franklyn. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the  Hecaton Machine Gun, which requires the Shockwave tech, and can be further evolved into  Divergence with Bombarding Fire tech. Fully evolving it unlocks  Eagle Gun starting weapon and solo skin for Formina Franklyn.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from  Intuition.
## Effects
Saber Machine Gun fires a barrage of bullets rapidly in the faced direction. Bullets have limited duration and can pierce through enemies.
Can glimmer the "Shockwave" tech, which creates explosions around random enemies.
Works best with  Speed and  Duration, which makes bullets reach further. Duration also makes barrage last longer.
## Arcanas
-  Heart of Fire (XIX) - Bullets explode upon hitting each enemies, dealing half its base damage in an area.
-  Heir of Fate (XIX) - The  Fire damage from this weapon would make the enemies it kills drop  Scorched Souls, a pickup that increases  Max Health and  Might.

## Effects
Sacred Beasts Tower Shield is much bigger and stronger than Guardian's Targe. Upon overhealing, it triggers both extra projectiles and temporary invulnerability, as well as silhouette of four sacred beasts by turns.
## Arcanas

Salamender is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Raging Fire, requiring Max level  Spinach. Evolving it keeps Raging Fire as a hidden weapon.
It is the starting weapon of  Dario Bossi [DLC].
## Effects
Salamender fires a snake of fire that travels in ∞ shape and damage all enemies it contacts.
The head of the snakes deals the base damage, while the tails deal significantly less.  Amount increases the number of snake segments.
## Arcanas
-  Gemini (I) - creates a counterpart - Speculo Raging Fire, which mirrors Salamender in opposite direction.
-  Heart of Fire (XIX) - Triggers explosions whenever the snake segments spawn from the red glyph and touches an enemy.
-  Heir of Fate (XIX) - The  Fire damage from this weapon would make the enemies it kills drop  Scorched Souls, a pickup that increases  Max Health and  Might.

Sanctuary is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Refectio, requiring Max level  Clover. Evolving it keeps Refectio as a hidden weapon.
## Effects
Sanctuary charges up a light that brightens the bottom of the screen. Once charged, it fully heals all characters by healing the different between the characters'  Max Health and current health, and purifies all enemies in sight, instantly killing them. This will bypass all instant kill resistance, so long as the enemy is on-screen, including  The Reaper but excluding enemies that take 0 damage for a period of time such as  The Ender and special bosses on Ode to Castlevania and Red Moon Manor.
- Since Sanctauary only heals to exactly 100% health, this part of the weapon is incapable of overhealing the player. It will also not increase  Megalo Miang Moonspell's [DLC] Max Health.
When evolving this weapon through Evolution chests, this weapon maintains the effects of Refectio and creates a blue magic circle under the character's feet. Once activated, the magic circle generates a holy zone with a cross above it, damaging enemies it contacts and healing characters on it.  Amount affects the holy zone's Duration. Healing is increased by the Recovery stat, with each 1  Recovery adding 1 health of healing. This effect won't be triggered if this weapon is picked up from the  Super Candybox II Turbo.

## Trivia

The Sanguine Star is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It becomes one of the two optional starting weapons of  Siugnas after fully evolving  Town Sword. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the  Blood Chalice, which requires the  Stone Mask and Blood Rage tech. Evolving it unlocks  Intuition.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from  Intuition.

Sanguine Star creates blood explosions at the nearest target, damaging all enemies in a small area.
Can glimmer the "Blood Rage" tech: damage x2, area x2.
Ignores Speed and Duration.

Santa Javelin is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.10. It is the starting weapon of  Santa Ladonna. It is unlocked by attaining its maximum level of 7.
Its evolution is  Seraphic Cry, which requires  Clover at max level.
## Effects
Santa Javelin intermittently drops icicles in a fan-shaped pattern from the sky onto the ground, each creating a blue shockwave at the point of impact that deals Area-of-Effect damage. Increases to  Duration increase  Amount.
By default, it is capable of dealing critical hits, which deal 2x damage and have 5% chance to occur. This chance is affected by Luck.
## Arcanas
-  Gemini (I) - Creates counterpart  Levelin'Eh. It levels up as Santa Javelin does and benefits from Limit Breaking. The icicles are more teal and they mirror where the normal Santa Javelin would shoot from the same origin.
-  Twilight Requiem (II) - The icicles from this weapon will generate explosions on impact. The damage of these explosions is based on  Curse.
-  Tragic Princess (III) - This weapon's cooldown is reduced when the character is moving.
## Levels
Santa Javelin has 8 levels. At max level, Santa Javelin has +50 Base Damage, +100% Area, +2 Amount, and -1.5 seconds to Cooldown.

Santa Water is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Suor Clerici. It is unlocked by default.
Its evolution is  La Borra, which requires  Attractorb.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from  Coat of Arms [DLC].
## Effects
Santa Water rains down bottles of holy water from the sky, which break upon impact with the ground, leaving puddles of water and blue flames that damage enemies.
Until Santa Water's total  Amount reaches four, the first bottle of each cast aims at the closest enemy. Otherwise, the bottles are dropped in a clockwise, roughly circular pattern.
Santa Water has a 0.5 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every half a second by the same puddle. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Arcanas
-  Tragic Princess (III) - Reduces Santa Water's  Cooldown when the character is moving. It is affected by  Move Speed.
-  Divine Bloodline (IX) - Allows Santa Water's puddles to deal extra flat damage based on  Armor.
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Aims at the nearest enemy instead of shooting randomly for every bottle even after four Amount, and gains  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.
-  Heir of Fate (XIX) - The  Fire damage from this weapon would make the enemies it kills drop  Scorched Souls, a pickup that increases  Max Health and  Might.
## Levels
Santa Water has 8 levels. At max level, Santa Water has +30 Base Damage, +80% Area, +3 Amount, and +1 second of Duration.
| Level | Description

| Level 7 | Effect lasts 0.3 seconds longer. Base Damage up by 5.
| Level 8 | Base Area up by 20%. Base Damage up by 5.

## Tips
- With enough  Duration and  Cooldown bonuses, Santa Water will replace itself fast enough to be persistent. With enough  Amount bonuses, an obvious circular pattern begins to form in the distribution of water puddles as it hits the Pool Limit. Combining all three, you can create a circle of Santa Waters around the player that never goes away.
- A particularly effective strategy is to combine this with  King Bible and  Garlic. Enemies will practically never be able to reach the player.
- The lingering areas can deal a lot of damage to multiple enemies, but due to its high Cooldown and somewhat unpredictable pattern, until it is leveled up enough with stat boosts from other sources, it should not be relied on as your main early game damage dealer.

## Trivia
- This weapon is inspired by the holy water sub-weapon from the Castlevania series with similar lingering area-of-effect damage, holy water benefits from Double and Triple Shot power ups in the games, it is referenced in the fact that Santa Water gain a lot more projectiles by leveling up.
- The name Santa Water is a purposely wrong translation of Holy Water in Italian, "Acqua Santa", as "Santa" means "holy" in Italian.
- The effect on the ground was intended to emulate the holy flames visual effect from Divinity II, according to the developer he "totally did not nail it".

Healing is doubled. Recovering HP damages nearby enemies for the same amount.
Sarabande of Healing (VI) is one of the Arcanas in Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked upon obtaining the  Randomazzo.
 Julia Laforeze [DLC] starts with this Arcana and has a special cosmetic effect.
## Overview
While Sarabande of Healing (VI) is active, all healing is doubled. Additionally, all healing triggers an Area-of-Effect damage pulse within a fixed range, dealing damage equal to the amount healed. The damage from the healing pulse does not benefit from  Might, and can only deal exactly the amount healed. It does not require missing health to deal damage either.
## Tips
- The healing pulse is affected by  Area. Since all the weapons also benefit from Area, they synergize well with this Arcana.
- Revival counts as healing to half health, and is doubled to become a full heal. If a character has high  Max Health (e.g.  Red Death, level 100+  Toastie), using a  Revival deals Max Health worth of damage to all surrounding enemies.
- Healing to full also restores the HP-Critical skills of characters like  She-Moon Eeta and  Bat Robbert, making them easier to trigger again after a death.
- Pairs well with  Disco of Gold (XV), as the collected coins heal for the same amount, doubled with this Arcana. Sends damaging pulses when coins are collected and applies during  Gold Fever.
-  Cosmo Pavone can deal massive damage with Sarabande pulses thanks to its scaling  Recovery.
- This Arcana can also be useful to characters with abilities that trigger upon overhealing by a certain amount, such as  Walter Bernhard [DLC], by making it easier to reach the overheal threshold.
- This Arcana synergizes well with Revival,  Armor, and Max Health.
- This Arcana doesn't actually affect the Recovery stat.
## Trivia
- The name of this Arcana is a reference to the song "Sarabande of Healing", which is Julia's shop music in Castlevania: Curse of Darkness.
- Sarabande of Healing (VI) can be unlocked in the  Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "randomazzami", the same spell that unlocks the Randomazzo.
- Sarabande of Healing (VI) is a representation of The Lovers Major Arcana card, symbolizing love, healthy relationships, choices, honesty, beauty, and healing.
- This is reflected in its ability to improve the player's own healing as well as allowing it to damage enemies.
- The pulse as a standalone weapon pulses periodically. It can be affected by  Amount and  Cooldown, which is not the case when it is an Arcana effect as it always pulses only once when healed. It can also be affected by Might as long as it has been modified to have some Base Damage.

Scarlet Needle is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Malice Bloodmoon. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with  Malice Bloodmoon. Alternatively, it can be unlocked in the  Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "eighthouse".
Its evolution is  Cardinal Rain which requires  Pummarola at max level.
## Effects
Scarlet Needle will drop needles on the nearest enemy, with  Amount increasing how many enemies can be attacked. If there are fewer enemies than the weapon's amount, then a single enemy will receive multiple needles.
 Duration (stat) has no effect on the duration of Scarlet Needle's needles; only level ups will increase the duration that they linger on the field.
Enemies hit by Scarlet Needle will be pinned in place for the remainder of the needle's duration, unable to move. This can even affect  The Reaper.
The damage of Scarlet Needle is displayed using "small" damage. The damage displayed by these numbers is approximately one tenth of the actual damage dealt.
Scarlet Needle deals  Blood damage.
Scarlet Needle has a 0.05 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 0.05 seconds by the same needle. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often. 
## Arcanas
-  Twilight Requiem (II) - Needles explode when they expire, dealing damage based on  Curse.
-  Tragic Princess (III) - Allows Scarlet Needle to fire faster while moving, increasing with  Move Speed.
## Levels
Scarlet Needle has 8 levels. At max level, Scarlet Needle has +1.5 Base Damage, +4 Amount, +30% Area, -0.6 seconds of Cooldown, and +0.5 seconds of Duration.

Screams from the Void is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Congregation. It is unlocked by getting it to level 7. It can alternatively be unlocked in the  Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "colorsoutofspace".
Its evolution is  Forbidden Siren, which requires max level  Attractorb.
## Effects
Screams from the Void causes shockwaves to occasionally ripple out from the player, dealing damage to enemies they contact with high levels of knockback.
The number of shockwaves done in a single attack increases with  Amount.
When the user is damaged, Screams from the Void will let out extra shockwaves in retaliation. Screams from the Void can retaliate at most every 1 second. If the enemy that triggered the retaliation is moving, Screams from the Void's shockwaves will track the enemy.
Screams from the Void has a 0.05 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 0.05 seconds by the same shockwave. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often. 
## Levels
Screams from the Void has 8 levels. At max level, Screams from the Void has +10 Base Damage, +60% Area, +2 Amount, and -1 second of Cooldown.

Seraphic Cryis an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.10. It is the evolution of the  Santa Javelin, and requires the  Clover at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
## Effects
Seraphic Cry summons an array of seraphs over enemies which shoot down a holy yellow light beam from the sky, each creating a yellow shockwave at the point of impact that deals Area-of-Effect damage. Increases to  Duration increase  Amount. It reduces the  Area of each shockwave and increases the Interval between each beam.  Luck increases the damage of this weapon up to a maximum of 11x at +900% Luck.
Collecting  Rosaries while Seraphic Cry is present also transforms them into Weird Souls Purifiers. Weird Souls Purifiers create four screen-clearing explosions. The drop weight of Rosaries is also multiplied by 3 while Seraphic Cry is present, making them drop more often from light sources and  Hail from the Future (X).
By default, it has a chance to deal critical hits, which deal 2x damage and have a 5% chance to occur. This chance is affected by Luck.

Shadow Pinion is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.5.2. It is the starting weapon of  Concetta Caciotta. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes as Concetta Caciotta.
Its evolution is  Valkyrie Turner, which requires  Wings.
## Effects
While moving, Shadow Pinion spawns projectiles in the form of drills that spawn behind the character, which slowly accelerate backwards and deal damage to enemies walking over them. When the character stops, all of them are fired in the direction the character is facing.
 Move Speed increases its overall spawn rate when moving; when the character stops, it initiates the default  Cooldown.  Area also increases how far the drills travel when they are fired.  Speed increases the acceleration.
The drills do more damage when fired based on the following formula: BaseDamage*(n+1), where n is equal to the number of seconds since the drill spawned. This only affects the damage when they are fired.
Shadow Pinion has a 2 second Hitbox Delay when staying on the ground, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 2 seconds by the same drill. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
While playing with a keyboard, the drills can only be shot out in eight directions: the cardinal and ordinal directions. When playing with a mouse or gamepad, the drills are able to be fired in any direction.
## Arcanas
-  Twilight Requiem (II) - Allows the Shadow Pinion's projectiles to explode when they expire. Damage is based on Curse.

Shadow Servant is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Genevieve Gruyère [DLC] and  Je-Ne-Viv [DLC].
Its evolution is  Ophion [DLC], which requires  Skull O'Maniac at max level.
## Effects
Shadow Servant spawns a snek that wanders out at a random enemy and explodes on them.
Enemies hit by Shadow Servant are slowed down permanently. The snek has a 50% chance to slow down enemies, affected by  Luck. If the enemy is not immune to debuffs, each hit reduces the Movement Speed of the affected enemy by an additional 5%, until it reaches a minimum of 20% of their original speed after 16 hits. The slow effect stacks multiplicatively with other Movement Speed modifications.
## Arcanas
-  Gemini (I) - Creates a counterpart -  Silver Sliver - that is functionally the same as Shadow Servant. It levels up as Shadow Servant does, spawning a more silvery snek that does not benefit from Limit Breaking.
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Aims at the nearest enemy instead of shooting randomly, and gains  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.

The Shaft Orb is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors.  Shaft starts with it as a hidden weapon.
The Shaft Orb that is summoned when reaching critically low health deals 20 base damage and covers most of the screen around the player character. The skill may only be activated again after recovering all HP. Receiving fatal damage resulting in a game-over will not trigger the skill.

Sharp Tongue is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Impostor Rina. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Impostor.
It can be evolved into  Impostongue with  Mini Impostor at max level. The passive item will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches level 2.
## Effects
Sharp Tongue fires seeking pink tongues in lines from the character to stab at nearby enemies in front of them. The damage of this weapon is multiplied by (1 + Recovery).
## Arcanas
-  Gemini (I) creates a counterpart,  Silver Tongue, that is functionally the same as Sharp Tongue. It fires silver and more curvy tongues which prioritizes enemies behind the character, and levels up as Sharp Tongue does but does not benefit from Limit Breaking.
## Levels
Sharp Tongue has 8 levels. At max level, Sharp Tongue has +30 Base Damage, +80% Area, and +3 Amount.
| Level | Description
| Level 1 | "Licks enemies in front of you. Damage multiplied by Recovery."
| Level 2 | Fires 1 more projectile. Base Area up by 20%.

## Tips
- It is best to combine Sharp Tongue into builds that utilize Pummarola and Metaglio Left as they increase the Recovery stat.
- Due to gaining +1 Recovery per level, Cosmo is able to quickly turn Sharp Tongue into a powerful weapon. By level 30 a Level 8 Sharp Tongue will deal 1500+ damage per hit when factoring in the Recovery, Might, and Omni Powerups.
## Trivia
- Sharp Tongue is based on the one of the death animation of an Impostor in Among Us, where the impostor uses their sharp tongue to pierce through a crewmate from behind.
- The weapon's name is a pun referencing the saying "Sharp Tongue", where someone with a sharp tongue tends to be more critical with their words, as well as the fact that the weapon is a literal tongue.
- Furthermore, the Gemini version of this weapon's name is "Silver Tongue" which is a phrase to refer to someone who tends to be persuasive with their words (and the weapon is also literal silver tongue).

Shimmering Sands is a weapon union from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of  Descent Into Misery and  Kyra-Stones.
## Effects
Shimmering Sands acts as a combination of its component weapons, keeping the slashing combo of 
 Descent Into Misery while replacing  Kyra-Stones' gem projectiles with its own, resembling particles of sand.
The sand crystals will appear above the player, dealing constant damage to any enemies they come in contact with. They will descend downwards at a rate determined by  Speed. The size of crystals, their lifetime and their quantity is determined by  Area,  Duration and  Amount, respectively. They deal fixed damage that increases by 1 for every level above 80, similar to  Kyra-Stones.
The slash attacks of Shimmering Sands will always trigger every part of the combo, regardless of player movement or luck. The damage of this combo scales with  Might and  Amount just like its predecessor, however, it loses the ability to deal critical hits. Acquiring  Slash (XVI) will not restore the ability to deal critical hits.
Whenever the combo attack begins, it will destroy the sand crystals one by one, the final attack destroying any remaining crystals. Sand crystals destroyed this way explode and deal damage to enemies nearby. Once the combo is completed, new crystals will fly onto the screen, aggressively charging at enemies before stopping right above the player.
## Arcanas
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Gains  Cooldown based on  Speed
- While Shimmering Sands will aim at the nearest enemy, the weapon's attack method causes this to seemingly have no effect.

## Tips
- Despite the sand crystals scaling with  Duration, the nature of the weapon makes them rarely last long enough to disappear on their own, making scaling it up unnecessary. The only time this scaling matters is if it goes into the negatives (possible with the use of  Survarocchi and especially  Enemahs).
- As the union loses the ability to deal critical hits, one could consider to keep  Descent Into Misery in its base form instead of uniting it if the player has already established a crit-focused build.
- At high amounts of cooldown reduction, the weapon will often break - its combo attack will not be able to complete, causing more and more sand crystals to generate. This can be beneficial as with so many crystals, they will act similarly to  La Borra in terms of protecting the player. If going for this state, consider also increasing  Area to cause crystals to overlap and deal more damage to enemies.

Short Gun is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Lance Bean [DLC]. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Lance Bean.
Its evolution is  Prototype B [DLC], which requires  Weapon Power-Up [DLC] and  Bracer.
## Effects
Short Gun fires a burst of short-range projectiles directly to the left or right of the character, depending on which direction they're facing. These projectiles can bounce off of enemies, rebounding towards the player.  Speed and  Duration can allow them to reach much further.
## Arcanas
-  Heart of Fire (XIX) - Allows Short Gun's projectiles to explode in an area upon contact, dealing half of its base damage in an area.
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Each projectile aims at the nearest enemy individually, and gains  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.
## Levels
Short Gun has 8 Levels. At max level, Short Gun has +40 Base Damage, +4 Amount, and +2 Pierce.

The Shuriken is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Quincy Morris. It is unlocked by getting the weapon to level 2.
Its Evolution is the  Yagyu Shuriken, which requires the  Empty Tome.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from  Coat of Arms.
## Effects
The Shuriken works just like Knife. It throws projectiles in the faced direction, but unlike the knife, it throws them at a small angle of spread.
## Arcanas
-  Iron Blue Will (VII) - Allows the Shuriken's projectiles to bounce off enemies up to three times, occassionally have infinite pierce, and pass through walls.
## Levels
The Shuriken has 8 levels. At max level, it has +10 Base Damage, +5 Amount, and +3 pierce.

Silver Revolver is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Henry. It is unlocked by upgrading it to level 6.
It can be evolved into  Jewel Gun with  Karoma's Mana. Evolving it unlocks  Cornell as a playable character.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from  Coat of Arms.
## Effects
The Silver Revolver fires a single bullet projectile at the closest enemy while standing still, or at faced direction while moving. Upon hitting an enemy the bullet splits into smaller line-shaped projectiles (affected by Amount) within a cone shape, dealing 1/3 Base Damage each and can pierce through enemies.
Every 6th activation, a revolver will be dropped as "reloading animation", which travels down and deals 1/3 Base Damage like an  Axe with limited duration.
Area affects size of both the bullet and revolver, but not split projectiles.
Limit break allows the player to increase the pierce (number of enemies that the bullet can pierce).

Silver Wind is a weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Miang Moonspell. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Miang.
Silver Wind can be evolved into  Festive Winds with  Pummarola at max level. Evolving it unlocks  Menya Moonspell as playable character.
## Effects
Silver Wind fires sparkling energy orbs that travel around the character in an oval-like pattern. The orbs are positioned relative to the character, and follow the character's movement.
 Area affects the orb's size and how far away from the player they travel.
Silver Wind has a 0.5 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every second by the same orb. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
Silver Wind has a 5% chance to generate little hearts that heal 1 point of health upon killing an enemy. This chance is affected by  Luck.
## Arcanas
-  Sarabande of Healing (VI) allows Silver Wind's little hearts to heal 2 points of health and trigger a pulse dealing the same amount of damage.
-  Twilight Requiem (II) allows the orbs to explode when they expire.
-  Divine Bloodline (IX) allows the orbs to deal extra flat damage based on  Armor.
## Levels
Silver Wind has 8 levels. At max level, Silver Wind has +20 Base Damage, +20%  Speed, +0.5 seconds to  Duration, +6  Amount, and -0.3 seconds to Interval.

Sinestro Custos is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is one of the starting weapon of  Cornell [DLC]. It is unlocked by upgrading it to Level 6. It can be found in Crystal Cave of Dracula's Castle after unlocking  Serpent Gate [DLC].
Its union is  Trinum Custodem [DLC], which also requires  Dextro Custos [DLC] and  Centralis Custos [DLC] at max level.
## Effects
Sinestro Custos summons the white, icy head of Cerberus that bites horizontally. It ignores  Speed and  Duration.  Amount increases the number of bite attacks. Area increases size and hitbox of the Cerberus head.

Sole Solution is a weapon and a gift in Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.11.0. It is the gift of the  Victory Sword and requires  Torrona's Box at max level. It does not replace the Victory Sword when obtained, and is instead given as a passive item without actually taking up any of the weapon or passive item slots.
## Effects
Before Sole Solution attacks, it generates sparkles out from the character. Sole Solution then summons a massive galaxy which swirls counter-clockwise, damaging everything on screen and making the character intangible until it ends after 10 seconds. When it ends, the galaxy quickly swirls clockwise and shrinks.
When the character is intangible,  Treasure Chests cannot be interacted with, but they can still collect pickups. However, they will not be collected and take effect until after Sole Solution's effect ends.
Its base damage increases by 1 per 5,000 enemies killed, without cap. This increase is retroactive.
Sole Solution has a 0.1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 0.1 seconds by the galaxy. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Levels
Sole Solution does not benefit from Limit Break.
## Combos
See Combos for a list of all item interactions.

## Tips
- Due to how the intangibility period delays the acquisition of  Experience Gems, it is recommended to be cautious when combining it with  Wicked Season (XIII) due to how it can potentially lock the player out of the majority of the cycling  Growth bonus that the Arcana provides. This is because of the fact that Sole Solution operates on a 20 second cycle unaffected by  Cooldown, meaning that two cycles perfectly line up with one full cycle of  Wicked Season (XIII) making it always active in the same points in its cycle.
- However, this is not foolproof, as lag can create a desync between both cycles.
- If done correctly, this can act as a way to effectively increase the duration of the  Growth bonus, as having the intangibility start midway through the  Luck bonus will delay all of the Experience Gems gained until the growth bonus begins.
- The intangibility does not delay the acquisition of  Gold, meaning that the  Greed bonus is less impacted by these issues.
- The exception to this is  Gold obtained via Level ups and  Treasure Chests.
## Audio
 Anticipation
Sound effect indicating Sole Solution's effect is about to start.
 First Impact
Sound effect when Sole Solution's effect begins.
 Second Impact
Sound effect for Sole Solution's effect ending.
## Trivia
- Sole Solution's symbol is an uppercase sigma, relating it to  Queen Sigma. Sigma is used as the symbol for summation (adding different terms together after subbing in incrementing values), hence the name containing "solution".

Song of Mana is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.3.0. It is the starting weapon of  Poppea Pecorina. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes as Poppea Pecorina.
Its evolution is  Mannajja, which requires  Skull O'Maniac.
## Effects
Song of Mana pulses a wave of sparkling particles outwards in the shape of a vertical ellipse, bouncing along the edges of a vertical column centered around the character. The particles are positioned relative to the character, and follow the character's movement.
Song of Mana has a 1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every second by the same pulse. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Arcanas
-  Divine Bloodline (IX) - Allows the Song of Mana to deal extra flat damage based on  Armor.
-  Blood Astronomia (XXI) - Allows the Song of Mana to emit special damaging zones. These zones take the form of several planets orbiting around a point.
## Levels
Song of Mana has 8 levels. At max level, Song of Mana has +30 Base Damage, +175% Area, +1.5 seconds to Duration, and +2.25 seconds to Cooldown.

## Tips
-  Area affects how wide the column is, making  Candelabrador one of the most effective ways to increase its effectiveness.
-  Duration is also extremely effective as it maintains the column for a longer time. Combined with reduced  Cooldown from items like  Empty Tome and  Spellbinder, multiple columns can be active at once.
## Trivia
- Song of Mana is the first weapon to have level ups that increase  Cooldown instead of reducing it.
- With high enough  Duration, the particles can bounce back and forth multiple times, filling the area around the character. This is only a visual effect.
- The music score used for the Song of Mana's sprite is the same as the page that falls out of  King Bible.
- This weapon may be inspired by the Hymn sub-weapon from the Castlevania series.

Sonic Bloom is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Browny [DLC]. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Browny.
Its evolution is  Wave Beam [DLC], which requires  Weapon Power-Up [DLC] and  Armor.
## Effects
Sonic Bloom fires a purple ring-shaped projectile with increasing size and limited  Duration in the faced direction. It starts with long  Cooldown, but can pierce through enemies (up to 2 at base).
## Arcanas
-  Waltz of Pearls (XI) - Allows Sonic Bloom's projectiles to bounce off enemies up to three times.
-  Pale Diamond Incursion (V) - Aims at nearest enemy, and gains  Cooldown bonus based on  Speed.

Sonic Bloom has 8 Levels. At max level, Sonic Bloom has +10 Base Damage, +150% Area, +1 Amount, +2 Pierce, +8.0 seconds Duration, and -1.0 second Cooldown.

Sonic Dash is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Nathan Graves. It is unlocked by defeating 6,000 enemies with  Nathan Graves.
Sonic Dash can be found in Ode to Castlevania stage after unlocking  Dracula, located in the middle of Sewer.
It can be evolved into  Rapidus Fio with  Wings at max level.
It can be selected when using the  Ebony Diabologue.
## Effects
When Sonic Dash is activated the character will be covered by a green sphere, temporarily boosting the character's Move Speed and damaging all enemies that get too close to the character (damage affected by Projectile Speed and Area). Sonic Dash also provide a passive Move Speed bonus.
## Arcanas
-  Blood Astronomia (XXI) - Creates a linear zone of red starlights at faced direction forward and backward. Occasionally, red constellations will be created across the linear zone, which will explode when being touched by an enemy, dealing area damage.

The Sonic Whip is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Sonia Belmont. It is unlocked by Surviving 8 minutes with Sonia.
Its Evolution is the  Crissaegrim Tip, which requires the  Skull O'Maniac.
As a magic whip, it can be picked from  Morning Star.
## Effects
The Sonic Whip is a weapon that flings out a waving projectile that only strikes out directly horizontal in the direction the character is facing. Unlike other Whips, the whip projectile is affected by Duration. The weapon has a chance to instant kill based on Curse.
Its separate projectiles fire in sequence instead of all at once, and can be split between the two horizontal directions by changing facing direction mid-attack.
## Arcanas
-  Slash (XVI) - Allows the Sonic Whip to critical hit. Its critical hits deal 4x damage and have a 5% chance to occur. This chance is affected by Luck.

Sorbetto is an item pickup in Vampire Survivors. It is also a hidden weapon wielded by  Frozenshade.
Sorbettos can be found from light sources while the player has  Out of Bounds (XII). They can also be found on the stage Whiteout, or dropped by  Hail from the Future (X).
## Effects
Similar to  Nduja Fritta Tanto, upon picking up the Sorbetto, the player's character begins to breathe a cone of icy wind in the direction they are facing, for 10 seconds. It also has the added effect of freezing the enemies it damaged. It is coded to be a temporary weapon, so it can be affected by different stat increases.
Collecting  Floor Chicken or  Wall Chicken while  Frozenshade is at max health has a chance of activating Sorbetto.
Sorbetto is affected by Gemini (I), causing it to emit frozen wind behind the character in addition to in front.
## Trivia
- Sorbetto is named after the sorbet, a frozen dessert.
- The codename for the weapon "CONEOFCOLD" is likely a reference to the spell "Cone of Cold" in Dungeons and Dragons.

Sossoldi is a hidden special weapon in Vampire Survivors, being only available in the Ante Chamber DLC. It is only used by  Outer Saboteur [DLC] and can not be obtained normally.
## Effects
Sossoldi shoots out  Gold Coins the player has collected through their run, slowly draining their gold. Projectiles improve as more coins are collected, shooting out  Gold Coins, then sometimes  Coin Bags,  Big Coin Bags, and  Rich Coin Bags eventually when collected their coin value times 1,000 coins, dealing damage and deduce the collected coins equal to their base coin value. However, because the threshold is based on the current coins collected rather than the total, it may cause the coin count to reach a lower threshold by using them up.
The thresholds and shoot chance are as follows:
| Coin Count | Shoot Chance
| Gold Coin | Coin Bag | Big Coin Bag | Rich Coin Bag
| 0 or below | N/A | N/A | N/A | N/A
| 1-9,999 | 100% | N/A | N/A | N/A
| 10,000-24,999 | 4/5 | 1/5 | N/A | N/A
| 25,000-99,999 | 2/3 | 1/6 | 1/6 | N/A
| 100,000+ | 4/7 | 1/7 | 1/7 | 1/7
Sossoldi also benefits from the stats of Outer Saboteur. If used by Outer Saboteur, it always fires with a 1-second  Cooldown but does not benefit from cooldown reduction, and the coin collected threshold is divided by 10 to 1,000, 2,500, and 10,000 respectively.
## Levels
Sossoldi has 8 levels. At max level, Sossoldi has +5 Amount, +4 Pierce, and -0.14 seconds of Interval.

Power increases when recovering HP.","union-item":"Anura","damage":"20 (+5)","knockback":"0","requires1":"Garlic","effects":"*Ignores Amount, Duration, and Speed.\n*Increases knockback and decreases freeze resistance.\n*Has a chance to generate Little Hearts when killing enemies.\n*Damage scales with damage healed.","union":"Dark Frogamorphosis","max-damage":"+60, does not increase by Might","type":"Evolution","requires2":"Pummarola","id":"VORTEX","speed":"-","cooldown":"1.0 second","area":"300% (+100%)"}
Soul Eater is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of  Garlic, and requires  Pummarola. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
It is the starting weapon of  Peppino.
Its union is  Dark Frogamorphosis [DLC], which also requires  Anura [DLC] at max level.
## Effects
Soul Eater places a circular black aura around the player that pulls particles and slowly pulses inward, dealing damage to enemies inside it.
Soul Eater has a larger increase in  Area and an increase in Base Damage.
 Cooldown acts similarly to Hitbox Delay for Soul Eater. Damage will be dealt instantly to an enemy if they have never been in the circle before, after which they cannot be hit by it again until Soul Eater's Cooldown is over, even if they temporarily leave its area.
Enemies hit by Soul Eater will take more knockback and be more vulnerable to freeze. If the enemy is not immune to debuff, each hit applies +0.3 knockback to the enemy until the maximum knockback they can take and -0.1 to freeze resistance until it reaches 0.
Soul Eater gains +1 damage every 60 health healed, capping at +60 damage or 3,600 health healed. This damage is just a flat increase and does not benefit from  Might. The source of the healing to boost Soul Eater's damage does not matter, passive  Recovery, the healing from  Floor Chicken, even the heal from  Revival counts toward damage healed. However, only healing that actually takes place is counted, overhealing does not.
Soul Eater has a chance to generate  Little Hearts that heal 1 health upon killing an enemy, multiplied by Recovery. This chance is unaffected by  Luck. Instead, it is based on how strong the attack is: if the damage dealt multiplied by 3/140 is greater than a randomly generated value between 0 and 1, a Little Heart will spawn.
## Arcanas
-  Tragic Princess (III) - Reduces Soul Eater's  Cooldown when the character is moving. It is affected by  Move Speed.
-  Sarabande of Healing (VI) - Allows Soul Eater's Little Hearts to heal double their amount and trigger a pulse dealing the same amount of damage.
-  Blood Astronomia (XXI) - Allows Soul Eater to place multiple damage zones on the ground.
-  Wandering the Jet Black (XXI) - Soul Eater increases the damage dealt by the explosive projectiles with the regained health.
## Levels
With Limit Break, Soul Eater can be further leveled up.
| Description | Rarity | Max Total
| Might +0.5% | 10 | -
| Area +2.5% | 10 | 1000%

## Tips
- The debuffs applied by Soul Eater are its most useful ability late game. Strong enemies that take multiple hits to kill will be easier to keep at bay thanks to increased knockback, and some boss enemies can become vulnerable to freezing when kept in the circle for long enough.
- Combined with a weapon to constantly knock enemies away, such as  Unholy Vespers or  Mannajja, Soul Eater can enable the player to sit entirely still.
-  Clock Lancet has natural synergy with Soul Eater; it decreases the enemy's resistance to freezing, allowing the Clock Lancet to freeze bosses, and even very powerful frozen enemies can easily be killed by keeping Soul Eater's area of effect over them.
- If the player intends to stay idle, Soul Eater works well when paired with the  Attractorb, as enemies that die instantly to Soul Eater may drop experience just out of reach of the player.
- Soul Eater's aura can kill most weak enemies instantly. Killing swarms of weak enemies can lead to windfalls of Little Hearts which can increase the damage output of Soul Eater.
- Because Soul Eater does not count any overhealing, you have to occasionally take damage and heal back up in order to gain stacks. Due to this, it does not pair well with  Laurel. With the  Bloody Tear,  Hollow Heart, and  Armor (for instance), the player can take less risk in taking a lot of damage, just to heal up easily to empower Soul Eater.
## Trivia
- This weapon is inspired by the Soul Eater Rune (which embodies Life and Death) from the Suikoden series.

Soul Steal is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Jiangshi, and can be purchased and unlocked from  Master Librarian [DLC] for 2,800.  Alucard [DLC] starts with a hidden version of this weapon that activates upon filling his charge ability by standing still.
Its union is  Power of Lire [DLC], which also requires  Vicious Hunger.
## Effects
Soul Steal damages all enemies in sight. Enemies it kills have a chance to be turned into  Little Hearts. This is the same effect that can be produced by  Karma Coins.

## Tips
- Soul Steal pairs well with  Babi-Onna [DLC] due to her passive. Babi-Onna's ability to ignore regular  Cooldown in exchange for firing weapons at fixed intervals while moving means Soul Steal can be set off as frequently as possible.
- This weapon pairs exceptionally well with characters like  Wind [DLC] who benefit from overhealing. When paired with enough extra  Recovery and  Sarabande of Healing (VI), this weapon can activate "Overheal" passives incredibly quickly.
## Trivia
- Soul Steal used to have 9 levels, with the effect of Level 7 (Cooldown reduced by 20 seconds) and Level 8 (Base Damage up by 30) being merged into the current Level 8.

Spectral Sword is a weapon selector from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It becomes available at the start of a stage when unlocked and equipped by an eligible character. It allows the player to select one of the Ode to Castlevania magic weapons, which includes:
-  Alucart Sworb
-  Tyrfing
-  Alucard Spear
-  Trident
-  Mace
-  Star Flail
-  Iron Shield
-  Guardian's Targe
-  Valmanway,  Icebrand,  Arrow of Goth,  Aura Blast,  Kaiser Knuckle and  Pocket Knife (once unlocked)
## Unlocking
The Spectral Sword is unlocked by evolving all 8 magic weapons that can be evolved, which refers to all the weapons above except  Valmanway,  Icebrand,  Arrow of Goth, and  Aura Blast. This does not have to be done in a single run. Alternatively, the player can start a run using  Saint Germain and selecting the Spectral Sword as a starting weapon.
## Eligible characters
Note that not of all eligible characters have a magic weapon as starting weapon.
-  Jonathan Morris [DLC]
-  Reinhardt Schneider [DLC]
-  Eric Lecarde [DLC]
-  Isaac [DLC]
-  Hector [DLC]
-  Maria Renard [DLC]
-  Saint Germain [DLC]
-  Jonathan & Charlotte [DLC]

SpellStream is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors.
Its union is  SpellStrom [DLC], which also requires  SpellString [DLC] and  SpellStrike [DLC] at max level.
## Effects
SpellStream shoots expanding blue magic zones at the closest enemy, the zone moves out a bit then pull toward to character.
Its damage is multiplied by 1.25x Area.
SpellStream has a 0.4 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 0.4 seconds by the same zone. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Levels
SpellStream has 6 levels. At max level, SpellStream has +15 Base Damage, +100% Area, and +0.5 seconds to Duration.

SpellStrike is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors.
Its union is  SpellStrom [DLC], which also requires  SpellString [DLC] and  SpellStream [DLC] at max level.
## Effects
SpellStrike creates a zone at the nearest enemy strike at them.
Its damage is further multiplied by 1.25x Might, which makes it one of the most powerful weapon that deals pure damage with high stats. This multiplier ignores the total Might cap of 1000%, allowing SpellStrike to scale infinitely.
SpellStrike has a 0.4 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 0.4 seconds by the same zone. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.

SpellString is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of  Eleanor Uziron [DLC].
Its union is  SpellStrom [DLC], which also requires  SpellStream [DLC] and  SpellStrike [DLC] at max level.
## Effects
SpellString shoots multiple blue strings of magic that sparkle at the closest enemy to the player.
Its damage is also multiplied by 1.25x Projectile Speed.
## Levels
SpellString has 6 levels. At max level, SpellString has +2 Base Damage, +5 Amount, and -0.05 seconds to Interval.

SpellStrom is a weapon union from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of  SpellString,  SpellStream, and  SpellStrike.
SpellString, SpellStream, and SpellStrike must be level 6 before SpellStrom becomes available.
Uniting it unlocks  Maruto Cuts as playable character.
## Effects
SpellStrom emits a lot of blue particles, creating two gravity wells which orbit around the character and leave behind a dotted particle path. Each well has a SpellString on it, and SpellStream and SpellStrike still work as normal, all at their level 6 strength. SpellString gets +10 base damage; SpellStream gets +100% Projectile Speed, +0.5 seconds to Duration, and +50% Area; SpellStrike gets +2 Amount. They also retain the Limit Break bonuses. All weapon components retain their respective stat damage multipliers: 1.25x Projectile Speed for SpellString, 1.25x Area for SpellStream, and 1.25x Might for SpellStrike.
Once in a while, Singularity starts with the two gravity wells spiral in and crash, dealing damage to all enemies. Its base damage is calculated by (base damage + total duration in seconds + total projectile speed + total area) x total amount. Its total damage increases by five every time it is triggered. It starts with a Cooldown of 40 seconds which consists of two parts: a 20 second cooldown that cannot be lowered, and another component which also starts at 20 seconds but can be lowered by the player's stats to a minimum of 2 seconds at -90% Cooldown, resulting in a minimum cooldown of 22 seconds.

Spirit Disturbance is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It is the evolution of  Unearthly Bolt, and requires  Tirajisú at max level.
## Effects
Spirit Disturbance spawns a green dragon on top of the screen, flying in an infinite symbol path. It shoots lightning bolts from its mouth and attacks the closest enemies around the character, they can chain to multiple enemies. It always deals critical hits, it does not provide a damage multiplier, instead creating an additional green explosion with fire particles floating up to damage enemies around the final chain target. Consecutive critical hits increase the damage of the weapon, granting an extra +1x per critical hit to the critical multiplier.  Revival increases the cap of this extra damage.
Furthermore, each Revival gives Unearthly Bolt +1  Amount each.
Spirit Disturbance has a 0.12 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 0.12 seconds by the same explosion. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Arcanas

Spirit of Light is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of  Summon Spirit [DLC] at max level and  Holy Wand.
## Effects
Spirit of Light creates a portal of light that orbits the character clockwise, constantly spawning homing spirits that shoot out in the direction the player is moving, which then seek out enemies. Much like Summon Sprit, its projectiles follow a spiral pattern, and their  Area is based on the square root of the player's area, rather than Area by itself.
Compared to  Summon Spirit, Spirit of Light has increased Base Damage, Pool Limit,  Speed,  Amount, and a faster  Cooldown.
Spirit of Light has a 0.5 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy can not be hit by the same spirit more than every 0.5 seconds. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
## Arcanas
-  Waltz of Pearls (XI) - Gives Spirit of Light's projectiles the capability to bounce off of enemies up to three times.
-  Out of Bounds (XII) - When paired with Jail of Crystal (XIV), enemies frozen by Spirit of Light's projectiles will explode.
-  Jail of Crystal (XIV) - Gives Spirit of Light a 25% chance to freeze enemies. This chance is affected by  Luck.
-  Crystal Cries (XII) - When paired with Jail of Crystal (XIV), enemies frozen by Spirit of Light's projectiles will drop  Crystallized Souls when killed.
